56## Component costs and bounds
57 
58The first three rows are synchronized medians of three calls after compilation on eight H100s,
59with BF16 compute, FP32 master weights, the full training batch and synthetic
60inputs at initialization. They do not measure time to a target quality.
61 
62| Component | Measured time per batch | What it excludes |
63| --- | ---: | --- |
64| Native training-loss forward | 61.532 ms | Backward, optimizer, data loading |
65| Native loss forward + backward | 156.900 ms | Optimizer, data loading |
66| Twelve Boost readouts | 61.226 s | Capture, parameter reconstruction, Cut, merging, optimizer |
67| Hidden-state forward, two final calls of a separate capture diagnostic | 55.14–55.39 ms | Vocabulary loss and all trai
 >ning work |
68| Forward returning captured states, same diagnostic | 61.50–61.59 ms | Vocabulary loss and all training work |
69| Full-scale reconstruction, Cut, future-token credit, merge | Unmeasured | No complete treatment exists |

71Evidence: [matched forward/backward](records/gpu-v11/candidate11-forward.json),
72[Boost](records/gpu-v10/candidate11-forward.json), and
73[capture](records/gpu-v7/candidate11-forward.json).
74The capture diagnostic suggests about 6.3 ms overhead in that setting. It is not
75a timing for all subsequent credit work. The 203.36 ms real-data optimizer-step
76median comes from a different workload; subtracting the synthetic profile from
77it does not isolate optimizer cost.
78 
79Each Boost readout uses 512 directions and both signs through the depth mixture,
80normalization and 16,384-way vocabulary loss. Twelve readouts therefore perform
8112,288 logical vocabulary-loss evaluations per token. They reuse clean activations
82and head projections; these are not 12,288 complete model forwards. The implementation
83tiles 16 directions and 64 tokens. Despite that reuse, its readouts cost **390.22×**
84the measured forward-plus-backward operation, or about 301× the separate median
85native optimizer step. At most seven complete readout cycles fit in 480 seconds
86before any other treatment work.
87 
88With this measured probe cost fixed, even making all other treatment operations
89free cannot yield a per-update speedup at equal useful progress. This is a result
90about the naive implementation, not an impossibility theorem for forward-only learning.
91 
92### The narrow plausible route to a speedup
93 
94Let F=61.53 ms be the measured target forward and T=156.90 ms its forward-plus-backward
95cost. Replacing one ordinary update with m target forwards and extra cost C has the
96optimistic component speedup T/(mF+C). With C=0, one forward permits at most 2.55×,
97two permit 1.27×, and three already lose. These omit optimizer and full-system costs.
98 
99A practical method needs far fewer probes, useful credit at low cost, and enough
100lasting progress to pay for parameter reconstruction, optimizer state, synchronization,
101rejected candidates and verification. A cheap tied drafter might rank updates that
102replace several hero updates. Four target forwards for unchanged/candidate comparisons
103on screening and confirmation batches already cost about 246 ms before proposal work.
104Parallel candidate execution can improve latency while increasing GPU-hours.
105 
106Forecasting an ordinary loss curve does not establish that a proxy can rank the
107effects of candidate parameter updates. Test ranking on fresh batches, compare against
108momentum extrapolation and step-size search, and check persistence under further
109training. Charge all proposal and verification costs. Sparse experts and fixed
110attention/head work can limit draft savings even when stored parameter count shrinks.
111Memory savings or a better discrete architecture could change the comparison, but
112neither benefit has been demonstrated here. No production speedup is established.
113 
114Dust's 1,000–10,000× headline compares population efficiency with EGGROLL weight-space
115ES, extrapolating beyond a measured population ladder. It is not a measured wall-clock
116speedup over backprop. At 10M tokens, Dust with 64 draws has loss 5.397, EGGROLL at
117approximately 16k has 6.033, and backprop has 4.989. Matching EGGROLL populations are
118fit-dependent extrapolations. See the [paper](https://qlabs.sh/research/dust) and
119[Appendix C–D](https://qlabs.sh/research/dust/appendix.html).
120 
121## Implementation and validation limits
122 
123Implemented components include independent Boost readouts and reconstruction for
124head/final-gain/depth-query, shared and routed expert matrices, conditional router
125matrices, latent output expansions and MLP causal convolutions. Router tests hold
126expert choices and capacity masks fixed. They leave discrete selection changes untested.
127Cut, future-token probes, attention internals, several normalization and embedding
128updates, latent input credit and trajectory merging remain incomplete.
129 
130The selected source recipe is [Noise Boost → Cut](https://github.com/qlabs-eng/noise/tree/5e0d53fd02fd769d573e07af0d382d
 >313c5ac878/train/val).
131Its attention and residual structure differ from Belay's; completing the transfer
132requires architecture-specific credit paths, especially for KDA recurrence.
133 
134Twenty-four CPU component checks pass on the pinned runtime, including independent
135finite-loss/native-gradient references, packed-document boundaries and two-device
136expert-parallel cases. Tests use native derivatives only as independent references;
137the implemented credit calculations use forward probes and linear operations.
138The broader historical affected-suite run was not fully green: 2,543 passed,
13917 failed, 13 skipped and five expected failures. Twelve failures reproduced in the
140untouched pinned checkout; four timeout cases passed at lower test concurrency;
141a dense KMA timeout remains unresolved.
142The packaging branch’s current-main affected-suite check produced 3,113 passes,
14311 failures, six skips and five expected failures. All 11 failures reproduced in
144a separate unmodified `3eb121f2ee` checkout. The packaged pinned-runtime checks
145passed 24/24; mechanical lint and the strict MkDocs build passed.
146 
147The old elementwise GPU tolerance, |a−b| ≤ 1e−5 + 1e−5|b|, was chosen for this port.
148With explicit user authorization, the bounded GPU screen instead requires finite
149final states, activation error RMS/reference RMS ≤0.005, absolute mean cross-entropy
150change ≤0.001 nats/token, and expert-slot disagreement ≤0.001 in every layer.
151CPU mathematical tolerances remain unchanged.
152 
153The final screen compares native forward with routing inspection against forward
154returning the complete activation capture, using final raw training weights (not
155EMA) and the first real training batch. Route disagreement is the fraction of
156token/selected-slot positions with differing expert identifiers; slot-order
157differences count. This trained-state screen passes the aggregate limits: relative RMS 0.003079,
158loss change +0.00000143, and worst-layer route disagreement 0.0005064. However, its
159maximum hidden-state difference is **12.078125**, and 1.4516% of elements fail the
160old tolerance. Passing does not establish equivalent credit estimates or training
161trajectories. [Complete diagnostics](records/full-control-v4/candidate11-validation.json).
162 
163`runtime.patch` includes the ungated expert shape correction, ordered FP32 local
164expert-output accumulation (fixing observed repeatability), shared compiler
165boundaries, no-tail configuration fix, selected routing logits, and a size-one
166mesh Muon fix with their focused regression tests. Some changes alter floating-point
167execution; the replication is not a bitwise reproduction of the historical run.

27def load_probe_manifest() -> dict:
28    """Verify every staged experiment file before running a measurement."""
29    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "gpu-probe-manifest.json").read_text())
30    for name, digest in manifest["experiment_files"].items():
31        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
32            raise ValueError(f"Experiment source mismatch: {name}")

36def load_model_config(*, source_sha256: str | None = None) -> reference_model.GrugModelConfig:
37    """Decode recorded fields after checking checkout revision or shipped source hash.
38 
39    Iris bundles omit Git metadata. GPU probes pass the source digest recorded
40    while staging the pinned checkout, including its explicit runtime patch.
41    """
42    record = json.loads(REFERENCE.read_text())
43    source = Path(reference_model.__file__).resolve()
44    if source_sha256 is not None:
45        actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
46        if actual_hash != source_sha256:
47            raise ValueError(f"Model source hash mismatch: {actual_hash}")
48    else:
49        revision = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source.parents[3]), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(
 >)
50        if revision != record["source_revision"]:
51            raise ValueError(f"Expected source {record['source_revision']}, got {revision}")
52    return draccus.decode(reference_model.GrugModelConfig, record["config"]["model"])
53

55def parameter_audit() -> dict:
56    """Infer every parameter shape and compare the total to the recorded run."""
57    record = json.loads(REFERENCE.read_text())
58    config = load_model_config()
59    mesh = AbstractMesh(
60        axis_sizes=(1, 1, 8, 1),
61        axis_names=("replica_dcn", "data", "expert", "model"),
62        axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * 4,
63    )
64    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(record["config"]["trainer"]["trainer"]["seed"])
65    with use_abstract_mesh(mesh):
66        shape = eqx.filter_eval_shape(reference_model.Transformer.init, config, key=key)
67    parameters = [
68        {
69            "path": jax.tree_util.keystr(path),
70            "shape": list(leaf.shape),
71            "size": leaf.size,
72        }
73        for path, leaf in jax.tree_util.tree_flatten_with_path(shape)[0]
74        if isinstance(leaf, jax.ShapeDtypeStruct)
75    ]
76    count = sum(entry["size"] for entry in parameters)
77    recorded_count = int(record["reference_summary"]["parameter_count"])
78    if count != recorded_count:
79        raise ValueError(f"Parameter mismatch: constructed {count}, recorded {recorded_count}")
80    return {
81        "source_revision": record["source_revision"],
82        "reference_run": record["url"],
83        "reference_sha256": hashlib.sha256(REFERENCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
84        "parameter_count": count,
85        "layer_stack_indices": shape.stack_layer_indices(),
86        "parameters": parameters,
87    }

36def measure_boost_hubs(
37    stages: tuple[SublayerCapture, ...],
38    tokens: jax.Array,
39    loss_weight: jax.Array,
40    key: jax.Array,
41    *,
42    head: jax.Array,
43    norm_gain: jax.Array,
44    query: jax.Array,
45    epsilon: float,
46    soft_cap: float,
47    relative_step: float,
48    token_chunk: int,
49    direction_chunk: int,
50    z_loss_weight: float,
51) -> tuple[jax.Array, ...]:
52    """Read every sublayer write through the shared final depth gate and head.
53 
54    Returned credits are unnormalized weighted sums, sharded like activations.
55    Every stage uses its own forward-loss measurements. No earlier credit is
56    passed through a subsequent nonlinear operation.
57    """
58    width = head.shape[0]
59    labels = jnp.pad(tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1)))
60    labels = jnp.where(loss_weight > 0, labels, -1)
61 
62    def local_readout(partial, sources, labels, weights, head, gain, query, directions):
63        shape = partial.shape
64        point = partial.reshape(-1, width)
65        fixed = sources.reshape(sources.shape[0], -1, width)
66        target = labels.reshape(-1)
67        weight = weights.reshape(-1)
68        count = point.shape[0]
69        padding = (-count) % token_chunk
70        point = jnp.pad(point, ((0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(-1, token_chunk, width)
71        fixed = jnp.pad(fixed, ((0, 0), (0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(fixed.shape[0], -1, token_chunk, width)
72        fixed = jnp.swapaxes(fixed, 0, 1)
73        target = jnp.pad(target, (0, padding), constant_values=-1).reshape(-1, token_chunk)
74        weight = jnp.pad(weight, (0, padding)).reshape(-1, token_chunk)
75 
76        def tile(_, args):
77            point, fixed, target, weight = args
78            credit = attnres_readout_credit(
79                point,
80                fixed,
81                query,
82                head,
83                gain,
84                target,
85                directions,
86                relative_step=relative_step,
87                chunk_size=direction_chunk,
88                epsilon=epsilon,
89                soft_cap=soft_cap,
90                z_loss_weight=z_loss_weight,
91            )
92            return None, credit * weight[:, None]
93 
94        _, credit = jax.lax.scan(tile, None, (point, fixed, target, weight))
95        return credit.reshape(-1, width)[:count].reshape(shape)
96 
97    specs = (
98        P(BATCH_AXES, None, None),
99        P(None, BATCH_AXES, None, None),
100        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
101        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
102        P(None, None),
103        P(None),
104        P(None),
105        P(None, None),
106    )
107    mapped_readout = jax.shard_map(
108        local_readout,
109        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
110        in_specs=specs,
111        out_specs=P(BATCH_AXES, None, None),
112        check_vma=False,
113    )
114    hub_credits = []
115    for index, stage in enumerate(stages):
116        directions = direction_frame(width, jax.random.fold_in(key, index))
117        arguments = (
118            stage.partial,
119            jnp.stack(stage.completed_sources),
120            labels,
121            loss_weight,
122            head,
123            norm_gain,
124            query,
125            directions,
126        )
127        hub_credits.append(mapped_readout(*(jax.sharding.reshard(a, s) for a, s in zip(arguments, specs, strict=True))))
128    return tuple(hub_credits)

131def measure_readout_parameters(
132    stages: tuple[SublayerCapture, ...],
133    tokens: jax.Array,
134    loss_weight: jax.Array,
135    key: jax.Array,
136    *,
137    head: jax.Array,
138    norm_gain: jax.Array,
139    query: jax.Array,
140    epsilon: float,
141    soft_cap: float,
142    head_step: float,
143    query_step: float,
144    token_chunk: int,
145    direction_chunk: int,
146    z_loss_weight: float,
147) -> ReadoutParameterCredit:
148    """Sum shared-head, final-gain and depth-query credits over chosen stages.
149 
150    The caller chooses stages: Boost uses intermediate readouts and the final
151    one; Cut uses the final readout. Results are global weighted sums, reduced
152    across the data/expert batch mesh. Normalize once by the global token weight
153    in the training estimator, not by the number of intermediate readouts.
154    """
155    width = head.shape[0]
156    labels = jnp.pad(tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1)))
157    labels = jnp.where(loss_weight > 0, labels, -1)
158 
159    def local_readout(sources, labels, weights, head, gain, query, directions):
160        sources = sources.reshape(sources.shape[0], -1, width)
161        target, weight = labels.reshape(-1), weights.reshape(-1)
162        padding = (-target.size) % token_chunk
163        sources = jnp.pad(sources, ((0, 0), (0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(sources.shape[0], -1, token_chunk, width)
164        sources = jnp.swapaxes(sources, 0, 1)
165        target = jnp.pad(target, (0, padding), constant_values=-1).reshape(-1, token_chunk)
166        weight = jnp.pad(weight, (0, padding)).reshape(-1, token_chunk)
167 
168        def tile(total, args):
169            sources, target, weight = args
170            credit = readout_parameter_credit(
171                sources,
172                query,
173                head,
174                gain,
175                target,
176                weight,
177                directions,
178                head_step=head_step,
179                query_step=query_step,
180                direction_chunk=direction_chunk,
181                epsilon=epsilon,
182                soft_cap=soft_cap,
183                z_loss_weight=z_loss_weight,
184            )
185            return jax.tree.map(jnp.add, total, credit), None
186 
187        initial = ReadoutParameterCredit(*(jnp.zeros_like(a, dtype=jnp.float32) for a in (head, gain, query)))
188        total, _ = jax.lax.scan(tile, initial, (sources, target, weight))
189        return jax.tree.map(lambda a: jax.lax.psum(a, BATCH_AXES), total)
190 
191    specs = (
192        P(None, BATCH_AXES, None, None),
193        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
194        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
195        P(None, None),
196        P(None),
197        P(None),
198        P(None, None),
199    )
200    mapped_readout = jax.shard_map(
201        local_readout,
202        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
203        in_specs=specs,
204        out_specs=ReadoutParameterCredit(P(None, None), P(None), P(None)),
205        check_vma=False,
206    )
207    total = ReadoutParameterCredit(*(jnp.zeros_like(a, dtype=jnp.float32) for a in (head, norm_gain, query)))
208    for index, stage in enumerate(stages):
209        arguments = (
210            jnp.stack((*stage.completed_sources, stage.partial)),
211            labels,
212            loss_weight,
213            head,
214            norm_gain,
215            query,
216            direction_frame(width, jax.random.fold_in(key, index)),
217        )
218        credit = mapped_readout(*(jax.sharding.reshard(a, s) for a, s in zip(arguments, specs, strict=True)))
219        total = jax.tree.map(jnp.add, total, credit)
220    return total
221

223def reconstruct_shared_experts(
224    model: native.Transformer,
225    capture: ForwardCapture,
226    hub_credits: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
227    *,
228    relative_step: float,
229) -> tuple[Relu2ParameterCredit, ...]:
230    """Reconstruct candidate 11's shared-expert matrices from measured MLP hubs.
231 
232    Credits already include token weights. Sum over all batch/expert shards,
233    without division; the estimator applies its single global normalization.
234    The input gate/norm require their own independent probes and are not
235    updated by this function.
236    """
237    cfg = model.config
238    if (
239        cfg.num_shared_experts != 1
240        or not cfg.shared_ungated_relu2
241        or cfg.shared_ungated_activation != native.UngatedExpertActivation.RELU2
242        or cfg.expert_leaky_slope != 0
243        or cfg.shared_expert_gate
244        or cfg.laurel_rank
245        or cfg.mlp_in_center
246        or cfg.mlp_in_whiten_power
247    ):
248        raise ValueError("Shared credit requires the candidate 11 expert configuration")
249 
250    def local(inputs, preactivation, weight, credit):
251        result = relu2_parameter_credit(
252            inputs.reshape(-1, inputs.shape[-1]),
253            preactivation.reshape(-1, preactivation.shape[-1]),
254            weight,
255            credit.reshape(-1, credit.shape[-1]),
256            relative_step=relative_step,
257        )
258        return jax.tree.map(lambda x: jax.lax.psum(x, BATCH_AXES), result)
259 
260    specs = (
261        P(BATCH_AXES, None, None),
262        P(BATCH_AXES, None, None),
263        P(None, None),
264        P(BATCH_AXES, None, None),
265    )
266    mapped = jax.shard_map(
267        local,
268        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
269        in_specs=specs,
270        out_specs=Relu2ParameterCredit(P(None, None), P(None, None)),
271        check_vma=False,
272    )
273    results = []
274    for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
275        if any(
276            x is not None
277            for x in (
278                layer.sconv_mlp_in,
279                layer.out_norm_mlp,
280                layer.mlp_out_scale,
281                layer.moe_out_gate_w,
282            )
283        ):
284            raise ValueError("Shared credit does not cover extra MLP transforms")
285        stage = capture.stages[2 * index + 1]
286        inputs = layer.mlp_gated_norm(layer.rms_mlp(stage.input))
287        preactivation = capture.shared_preactivations[index].reshape(*inputs.shape[:-1], -1)
288        credit = hub_credits[2 * index + 1]
289        if layer.sconv_mlp is not None:
290            credit = causal_convolution_credit(
291                credit,
292                jax.sharding.reshard(layer.sconv_mlp.weight, P(None, None)),
293                capture.segment_ids,
294            )
295        arguments = (inputs, preactivation, layer.shared[0].w_down, credit)
296        results.append(mapped(*(jax.sharding.reshard(a, s) for a, s in zip(arguments, specs, strict=True))))
297    return tuple(results)
298

300def _routed_hub_credit(layer: native.Block, credit: jax.Array, segment_ids: jax.Array | None) -> jax.Array:
301    mlp = layer.mlp
302    if layer.sconv_mlp is not None:
303        credit = causal_convolution_credit(
304            credit,
305            jax.sharding.reshard(layer.sconv_mlp.weight, P(None, None)),
306            segment_ids,
307        )
308    credit = credit.reshape(-1, credit.shape[-1])
309    if mlp.w_latent_up is not None:
310        credit = jnp.einsum(
311            "td,ld->tl",
312            credit,
313            jax.sharding.reshard(mlp.w_latent_up, P(None, None)).astype(jnp.float32),
314            out_sharding=P(BATCH_AXES, None),
315        )
316    return credit
317

319def _routed_capacity(mlp: native.MoEMLP) -> tuple[float, float]:
320    capacity = mlp.expert_mlp.capacity_factor
321    transport_capacity = mlp.expert_mlp.pooled_transport_capacity_factor
322    if jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh().shape["expert"] == 1:
323        # Native moe_mlp uses dropless local scatter without expert parallelism.
324        capacity = float(mlp.cfg.num_experts)
325        transport_capacity = 1.0
326    return capacity, transport_capacity

329def reconstruct_routed_experts(
330    model: native.Transformer,
331    capture: ForwardCapture,
332    hub_credits: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
333    *,
334    relative_step: float,
335) -> tuple[Relu2ParameterCredit, ...]:
336    """Reconstruct routed expert matrices from independently measured MLP hubs.
337 
338    Transport credit through the fixed output convolution and latent expansion,
339    then probe the expert ReLU² once. Routing, normalization, latent projection
340    and depth-gate updates require independent probes and are excluded here.
341    """
342    results = []
343    for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
344        mlp = layer.mlp
345        if (
346            mlp.cfg.moe_implementation != "fixed_pooled_wave_all_to_all"
347            or mlp.cfg.moe_expert_waves != 1
348            or mlp.cfg.moe_fp8_dispatch
349            or not mlp.cfg.moe_drop_renorm
350            or mlp.latent_out_norm is not None
351            or mlp.expert_mlp.w_gate is not None
352            or mlp.expert_mlp_b is not None
353            or mlp.cfg.expert_leaky_slope != 0
354        ):
355            raise ValueError("Routed credit requires candidate 11's expert configuration")
356        credit = _routed_hub_credit(layer, hub_credits[2 * index + 1], capture.segment_ids)
357        capacity, transport_capacity = _routed_capacity(mlp)
358        results.append(
359            pooled_relu2_parameter_credit(
360                capture.routed_inputs[index],
361                capture.routing_selected[index],
362                capture.routing_weights[index],
363                mlp.expert_mlp.w_up,
364                mlp.expert_mlp.w_down,
365                credit,
366                capacity_factor=capacity,
367                transport_capacity_factor=transport_capacity,
368                relative_step=relative_step,
369            )
370        )
371    return tuple(results)

374def reconstruct_router_matrices(
375    model: native.Transformer,
376    capture: ForwardCapture,
377    hub_credits: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
378    *,
379    sigma: float,
380) -> tuple[jax.Array, ...]:
381    """Measure selected-logit responses and reconstruct each router matrix.
382 
383    This is conditional credit through candidate 11's sqrt-softplus combine.
384    It neither explores alternative selected experts nor updates the separate
385    quantile-balancing bias. Those biases use the native forward statistics.
386    """
387    results = []
388    for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
389        mlp = layer.mlp
390        if (
391            mlp.cfg.router_combine != native.RouterCombine.SQRT_SOFTPLUS_RENORM
392            or mlp.router is None
393            or mlp.router_up is not None
394            or mlp.router_mlp_a is not None
395            or mlp.router_logit_scale is not None
396            or mlp.cfg.router_logit_soft_cap is not None
397            or mlp.expert_output_gain is not None
398            or mlp.latent_out_norm is not None
399            or mlp.expert_mlp.w_gate is not None
400            or mlp.cfg.moe_ungated_activation != native.UngatedExpertActivation.RELU2
401            or mlp.cfg.moe_implementation != "fixed_pooled_wave_all_to_all"
402            or mlp.cfg.moe_expert_waves != 1
403            or mlp.cfg.moe_fp8_dispatch
404            or not mlp.cfg.moe_drop_renorm
405        ):
406            raise ValueError("Router credit requires candidate 11's combine and expert configuration")
407        router_input = layer.mlp_gated_norm(layer.rms_mlp(capture.stages[2 * index + 1].input))
408        credit = _routed_hub_credit(layer, hub_credits[2 * index + 1], capture.segment_ids)
409        capacity, transport_capacity = _routed_capacity(mlp)
410        results.append(
411            pooled_router_parameter_credit(
412                capture.routed_inputs[index],
413                capture.routing_selected[index],
414                capture.routing_logits[index],
415                mlp.expert_mlp.w_up,
416                mlp.expert_mlp.w_down,
417                credit,
418                router_input.reshape(-1, router_input.shape[-1]),
419                capacity_factor=capacity,
420                transport_capacity_factor=transport_capacity,
421                sigma=sigma,
422                renorm_sum=mlp.cfg.routing_renorm_sum,
423            )
424        )
425    return tuple(results)
426 
427 
428def reconstruct_latent_expansions(
429    model: native.Transformer,
430    capture: ForwardCapture,
431    hub_credits: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
432) -> tuple[jax.Array | None, ...]:
433    """Reconstruct the linear expansion after each routed-expert combination.
434 
435    Replay native dispatch and drop renormalization with frozen routing. The
436    expansion reads those clean activations and independently measured MLP hub
437    credit, transported through the fixed output convolution. No nonlinear
438    derivative or additional nonlinear credit transport is used. Candidate 11's
439    final two layers write at full width directly and return None in their slots.
440    """
441 
442    def local_matrix(inputs, credit):
443        return jax.lax.psum(inputs.astype(jnp.float32).T @ credit.astype(jnp.float32), BATCH_AXES)
444 
445    spec = P(BATCH_AXES, None)
446    matrix_credit = jax.shard_map(
447        local_matrix,
448        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
449        in_specs=(spec, spec),
450        out_specs=P(None, None),
451        check_vma=False,
452    )
453    results = []
454    for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
455        mlp = layer.mlp
456        if mlp.w_latent_up is None:
457            results.append(None)
458            continue
459        if mlp.latent_out_norm is not None or mlp.expert_mlp_b is not None:
460            raise ValueError("Latent expansion credit requires candidate 11's single expert bank")
461        inputs = capture.routed_inputs[index]
462        weights = capture.routing_weights[index]
463        combined, overflow = native._run_expert_bank(
464            mlp.expert_mlp,
465            native._bank_config(mlp.cfg, 1),
466            inputs,
467            capture.routing_selected[index],
468            weights.astype(inputs.dtype),
469        )
470        if overflow.assignment_keep is not None:
471            factor, _ = native._drop_renorm_factor(weights, overflow.assignment_keep)
472            combined = combined * factor[:, None].astype(combined.dtype)
473        credit = hub_credits[2 * index + 1]
474        if layer.sconv_mlp is not None:
475            credit = causal_convolution_credit(
476                credit,
477                jax.sharding.reshard(layer.sconv_mlp.weight, P(None, None)),
478                capture.segment_ids,
479            )
480        results.append(
481            matrix_credit(
482                jax.sharding.reshard(combined, spec),
483                jax.sharding.reshard(credit.reshape(-1, credit.shape[-1]), spec),
484            )
485        )
486    return tuple(results)
487 
488 
489def reconstruct_mlp_convolutions(
490    model: native.Transformer,
491    capture: ForwardCapture,
492    hub_credits: tuple[jax.Array, ...],
493) -> tuple[jax.Array | None, ...]:
494    """Reconstruct MLP output-convolution weights from independent hub credit.
495 
496    Replay each native MLP branch up to its convolution. Contract those inputs
497    with the original measured output credit, restricting every lag to its
498    packed document. This is linear parameter reconstruction without backprop.
499    """
500    segments = capture.segment_ids
501    mask = AttentionMask(
502        is_causal=True,
503        segment_ids=None if segments is None else (segments, segments),
504    )
505    spec = P(BATCH_AXES, None, None)
506    results = []
507    for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
508        if layer.sconv_mlp is None:
509            results.append(None)
510            continue
511        if layer.out_norm_mlp is not None or layer.mlp_out_scale is not None:
512            raise ValueError("Convolution credit requires an untransformed branch output")
513        kernel_size = layer.sconv_mlp.kernel_size
514        before_convolution = eqx.tree_at(lambda block: block.sconv_mlp, layer, None)
515        inputs, _ = before_convolution.mlp_branch(capture.stages[2 * index + 1].input, mask)
516 
517        def local(inputs, credit, segments, kernel_size=kernel_size):
518            weights = causal_convolution_parameter_credit(inputs, credit, segments, kernel_size=kernel_size)
519            return jax.lax.psum(weights, BATCH_AXES)
520 
521        mapped = jax.shard_map(
522            local,
523            mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
524            in_specs=(spec, spec, None if segments is None else P(BATCH_AXES, None)),
525            out_specs=P(None, None),
526            check_vma=False,
527        )
528        result = mapped(
529            jax.sharding.reshard(inputs, spec),
530            jax.sharding.reshard(hub_credits[2 * index + 1], spec),
531            segments,
532        )
533        results.append(jax.sharding.reshard(result, native._partition_spec_of(layer.sconv_mlp.weight)))
534    return tuple(results)

26GROUPS = (

49def capture_subset(model, tokens, mask, *, fields):
50    hidden, capture = capture_forward(model, tokens, mask)
51    if fields is None:
52        return hidden, capture
53    return hidden, tuple(
54        (
55            tuple(getattr(stage, name.removeprefix("stage:")) for stage in capture.stages)
56            if name.startswith("stage:")
57            else getattr(capture, name)
58        )
59        for name in fields
60    )
61 
62 
63def main():
64    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
65    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
66    parser.add_argument("--query-scale", type=float, required=True)
67    parser.add_argument("--groups", nargs="+", choices=[label for label, _ in GROUPS])
68    args = parser.parse_args()
69    manifest = load_probe_manifest()
70    cfg = load_model_config(source_sha256=manifest["model_source_sha256"])
71    devices = jax.devices()
72    if len(devices) != 1 or devices[0].platform != "gpu":
73        raise ValueError("Capture isolation requires one GPU")
74    mesh = Mesh(
75        np.asarray(devices).reshape(1, 1, 1, 1),
76        ("replica_dcn", "data", "expert", "model"),
77        axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * 4,
78    )
79    result = {
80        "kind": "synthetic_capture_output_isolation",
81        "manifest": manifest,
82        "batch": 8,
83        "sequence": 128,
84        "query_scale": args.query_scale,
85        "xla_flags": os.environ.get("XLA_FLAGS", ""),
86        "comparisons": [],
87    }
88    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
89    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
90        began = time.perf_counter()
91        model = eqx.filter_jit(Transformer.init)(cfg, key=jax.random.PRNGKey(0))
92        paths, structure = jax.tree_util.tree_flatten_with_path(model)
93        keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.PRNGKey(33), len(paths))
94        model = jax.tree.unflatten(
95            structure,
96            [
97                (
98                    value + args.query_scale * jax.random.normal(key, value.shape)
99                    if "attn_res_query" in jax.tree_util.keystr(path)
100                    else value
101                )
102                for (path, value), key in zip(paths, keys, strict=True)
103            ],
104        )
105        model = jmp.get_policy("bf16").cast_to_compute(model)
106        jax.block_until_ready(model)
107        result["initialization_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - began
108        result["parameter_count"] = sum(x.size for x in jax.tree.leaves(model))
109        spec = NamedSharding(mesh, P(("replica_dcn", "data", "expert"), None))
110        rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
111        tokens = jax.device_put(rng.integers(0, cfg.vocab_size, (8, 128), dtype=np.int32), spec)
112        segments = jax.device_put(np.broadcast_to(np.arange(128, dtype=np.int32) // 64, (8, 128)), spec)
113        mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, segment_ids=(segments, segments))
114        native_executable = eqx.filter_jit(native_forward)
115        expected = native_executable(model, tokens, mask)
116        jax.block_until_ready(expected)
117        repeated = native_executable(model, tokens, mask)
118        jax.block_until_ready(repeated)
119        repeat_delta = jnp.abs(repeated.astype(jnp.float32) - expected.astype(jnp.float32))
120        result["native_repeat_max_error"] = float(jnp.max(repeat_delta))
121        result["native_repeat_fraction_outside_tolerance"] = float(
122            jnp.mean(repeat_delta > 1e-5 + 1e-5 * jnp.abs(expected))
123        )
124        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
125        if result["native_repeat_fraction_outside_tolerance"] > 0:
126            result["outcome"] = "native_execution_not_repeatable_at_tolerance"
127            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
128            print(
129                json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "manifest"}),
130                flush=True,
131            )
132            return
133        for label, fields in GROUPS:
134            if args.groups is not None and label not in args.groups:
135                continue
136            began = time.perf_counter()
137            compiled = eqx.filter_jit(capture_subset)
138            hidden, subset = compiled(model, tokens, mask, fields=fields)
139            jax.block_until_ready((hidden, subset))
140            delta = jnp.abs(hidden.astype(jnp.float32) - expected.astype(jnp.float32))
141            row = {
142                "group": label,
143                "compile_and_call_seconds": time.perf_counter() - began,
144                "max_error": float(jnp.max(delta)),
145                "mean_error": float(jnp.mean(delta)),
146                "fraction_outside_tolerance": float(jnp.mean(delta > 1e-5 + 1e-5 * jnp.abs(expected))),
147            }
148            repeated, _ = compiled(model, tokens, mask, fields=fields)
149            jax.block_until_ready(repeated)
150            row["repeat_max_error"] = float(jnp.max(jnp.abs(repeated.astype(jnp.float32) - hidden.astype(jnp.float32))))
151            result["comparisons"].append(row)
152            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
153            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
154            del hidden, subset, compiled
155            if label == "all" and row["fraction_outside_tolerance"] == 0:
156                result["outcome"] = "not_reproduced_at_reduced_batch"
157                break
158        result.setdefault("outcome", "output_groups_measured")
159        result["device_memory"] = devices[0].memory_stats()
160    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
161 
162 
163if __name__ == "__main__":
164    main()

47def native_control(model_config, *, record, model_key, schedule_steps):
48    """Build the native state and native update, preserving optimizer and EMA."""
49    trainer = record["trainer"]
50    mp = jmp.get_policy("params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16")
51    optimizer = draccus.decode(GrugMoeMuonHConfig, record["optimizer"]).build(schedule_steps)
52    state = eqx.filter_jit(initial_state)(
53        model_config,
54        optimizer=optimizer,
55        mp=mp,
56        key=model_key,
57        ema_beta=trainer["ema_beta"],
58    )
59    update = _make_train_step(
60        optimizer,
61        mp,
62        z_loss_weight=trainer["z_loss_weight"],
63        ema_beta=trainer["ema_beta"],
64        ema_start_step=max(0, schedule_steps - trainer["ema_last_steps"]),
65        head_replay_period=trainer["head_replay_period"],
66        head_replay_scale=trainer["head_replay_scale"],
67        watch_config=draccus.decode(WatchConfig, trainer["trainer"]["watch"]),
68        grad_accum_microbatches=trainer["grad_accum_microbatches"],
69    )
70    leaves, structure = jax.tree.flatten(state)
71    return leaves, structure, _flat_train_step(update, structure), mp
72

74def main():
75    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

77    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)

81        raise ValueError("At least two steps are required to measure steady cost")

33        tokenizer=str(tokenizer_path.resolve()),
34    )
35    schedule = BatchSchedule(trainer["train_batch_size"])
36    dataset = build_train_dataset(
37        config,

45def main():
46    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
47    parser.add_argument("--start-step", type=int, required=True)
48    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, required=True)

51    args = parser.parse_args()
52    if args.start_step < 0 or args.steps < 1:
53        raise ValueError("Require a nonnegative start step and positive batch count")
54    configure_coreweave_s3()
55    began = time.perf_counter()
56    dataset, schedule, config = native_train_dataset(args.tokenizer)
57    dataset = dataset.as_sync_dataset()
58    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
59    records = []
60    for step in range(args.start_step, args.start_step + args.steps):
61        start = schedule.global_data_offset_by_step(step)
62        count = schedule.batch_size_at_step(step)
63        examples = dataset.get_batch(range(start, start + count))
64        arrays = {
65            "tokens": np.stack([np.asarray(x.tokens) for x in examples]),
66            "loss_weight": np.stack([np.asarray(x.loss_weight) for x in examples]),
67            "segment_ids": np.stack([np.asarray(x.attn_mask.segment_ids[0]) for x in examples]),
68        }
69        path = args.output / f"batch-{step:06d}.npz"
70        np.savez(path, **arrays)
71        record = {
72            "step": step,
73            "dataset_indices": [start, start + count],
74            "shape": list(arrays["tokens"].shape),
75            "token_min": int(arrays["tokens"].min()),
76            "token_max": int(arrays["tokens"].max()),
77            "loss_weight_sum": float(arrays["loss_weight"].sum()),
78            "document_starts": int(np.sum(arrays["segment_ids"][:, 1:] != arrays["segment_ids"][:, :-1])),
79            "array_sha256": {k: hashlib.sha256(v.tobytes()).hexdigest() for k, v in arrays.items()},
80        }
81        records.append(record)
82        print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
83    report = {
84        "reference_sha256": hashlib.sha256(REFERENCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
85        "tokenizer": config.tokenizer,
86        "tokenizer_file_sha256": {
87            p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(args.tokenizer.iterdir()) if p.is_file()
88        },
89        "eos_token_id": config.the_tokenizer.eos_token_id,
90        "pipeline": "experiments.grug.fast_track.train.build_train_dataset",
91        "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter() - began,
92        "batches": records,
93    }
94    (args.output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")

4"""Candidate 11 forward replay with explicit sublayer intervention sites.
5 
6The original model owns every attention and expert computation. This module
7exposes its residual history so Boost/Cut can measure loss responses at those
8sites without invoking a backward pass. Only the candidate 11 recipe is covered.
9"""
10 
11from typing import NamedTuple
12 
13import jax
14import jax.numpy as jnp
15from levanter.grug.attention import AttentionMask, fa4_cute_segment_bounds
16 
17from experiments.grug.fast_track import model as native
18 
19 
20class SublayerCapture(NamedTuple):
21    completed_sources: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
22    partial_before: jax.Array | None
23    input: jax.Array
24    output: jax.Array
25    partial: jax.Array
26 
27 
28class ForwardCapture(NamedTuple):
29    token_rows: jax.Array
30    bigram_ids: jax.Array
31    bigram_rows: jax.Array
32    embedding: jax.Array
33    bigram_source: jax.Array
34    stages: tuple[SublayerCapture, ...]
35    final_sources: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
36    final_stream: jax.Array
37    shared_preactivations: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
38    segment_ids: jax.Array | None
39    routing_selected: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
40    routing_weights: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
41    routing_logits: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
42    routed_inputs: tuple[jax.Array, ...]
43 
44 
45def capture_forward(
46    model: native.Transformer,
47    token_ids: jax.Array,
48    mask: AttentionMask,
49    *,
50    interventions: tuple[jax.Array, ...] = (),
51) -> tuple[jax.Array, ForwardCapture]:
52    """Return final normalized hidden states and the executed forward history.
53 
54    Interventions, when supplied, add to each attention/MLP branch output in
55    execution order and are included in the captured history. Downstream
56    computation is replayed in full. This replay is an intervention oracle;
57    it is not yet Cut's frozen-context carrier.
58    """
59    cfg = model.config
60    layers = model.layers()
61    if interventions and len(interventions) != 2 * len(layers):
62        raise ValueError("One intervention per attention/MLP branch is required")
63 
64    token_rows = native._embedding_gather(model.token_embed, token_ids)
65    embedding = native._activation_boundary(model.embed_norm(token_rows))
66    segment_ids = None
67    if mask.segment_ids is not None:
68        segments = native._batch_reshard(mask.segment_ids[0])
69        segment_ids = (segments, segments)
70    else:
71        segments = None
72    long_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, segment_ids=segment_ids)
73    short_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, sliding_window=cfg.sliding_window, segment_ids=segment_ids)
74    batch_size, seq_len = token_ids.shape
75    long_bounds, valid = fa4_cute_segment_bounds(long_mask, batch_size=batch_size, seq_len=seq_len, sliding_window=None)
76    short_bounds, _ = fa4_cute_segment_bounds(
77        short_mask,
78        batch_size=batch_size,
79        seq_len=seq_len,
80        sliding_window=cfg.sliding_window,
81    )
82    valid = native._batch_reshard(valid)
83    long_mask = long_mask.with_fa4_bounds(native._batch_reshard(long_bounds), valid)
84    short_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, segment_ids=segment_ids).with_fa4_bounds(
85        native._batch_reshard(short_bounds), valid
86    )
87 
88    bigram_ids = native._bigram_hash_ids(token_ids, segments, cfg.embed2_rows, cfg.embed2_ngram)
89    bigram_rows = native._table2_gather(cfg)(model.token_embed2, bigram_ids)
90    bigram_source, _ = native._content_gate(
91        embedding,
92        model.embed2_norm(bigram_rows),
93        model.bigram_gate_w,
94        model.bigram_gate_b,
95        model.bigram_gate_a_lr,
96        model.bigram_gate_b_lr,
97        act=cfg.bigram_gate_act,
98        logit_scale=cfg.bigram_gate_logit_scale,
99    )
100 
101    queries = jnp.stack(
102        [query for layer in layers for query in (layer.attn_res_query_attn, layer.attn_res_query_mlp)]
103        + [model.attn_res_query_final]
104    )
105    eps = cfg.layer_norm_eps
106    blocks = (bigram_source,)
107    block_logits = (native._attn_res_source_logits(bigram_source, queries, eps),)
108    partial = embedding
109    captures = []
110    shared_preactivations = []
111    routing_selected = []
112    routing_weights = []
113    routing_logits = []
114    routed_inputs = []
115    segment_size = max(1, cfg.num_layers // cfg.attn_res_num_blocks)
116    for index, layer in enumerate(layers):
117        if index % segment_size == 0 and index // segment_size < cfg.attn_res_num_blocks:
118            blocks = (*blocks, partial)
119            block_logits = (
120                *block_logits,
121                native._attn_res_source_logits(partial, queries[2 * index :], eps),
122            )
123            partial = None
124        use_long = native._is_long_layer(index, cfg.num_layers, cfg.global_every, cfg.global_layers)
125        layer_mask = long_mask if use_long else short_mask
126        partial_before = partial
127        attn_input, _, _ = native._attn_res_mix(blocks, block_logits, partial, queries, 2 * index, eps)
128        attn_output, _ = layer.attn_branch(attn_input, layer_mask, use_long, use_long, token_ids)
129        if interventions:
130            attn_output = (attn_output.astype(jnp.float32) + interventions[2 * index]).astype(attn_output.dtype)
131        partial = attn_output if partial is None else partial + attn_output
132        captures.append(SublayerCapture(blocks, partial_before, attn_input, attn_output, partial))
133 
134        partial_before = partial
135        mlp_input, _, _ = native._attn_res_mix(blocks, block_logits, partial, queries, 2 * index + 1, eps)
136        mlp_output, mlp_stats = layer.mlp_branch(mlp_input, layer_mask)
137        shared_preactivations.append(mlp_stats[native._SHARED_PRE])
138        routing_selected.append(mlp_stats[native._ROUTING_SELECTED])
139        routing_weights.append(mlp_stats[native._ROUTING_WEIGHTS])
140        routing_logits.append(mlp_stats[native._ROUTING_LOGITS])
141        routed_inputs.append(mlp_stats[native._ROUTED_INPUT])
142        if interventions:
143            mlp_output = (mlp_output.astype(jnp.float32) + interventions[2 * index + 1]).astype(mlp_output.dtype)
144        partial = partial + mlp_output
145        captures.append(SublayerCapture(blocks, partial_before, mlp_input, mlp_output, partial))
146 
147    final_index = len(queries) - 1
148    final_sources = (*blocks, partial)
149    logits = [native._block_logit(logits, queries, final_index) for logits in block_logits]
150    logits.append(native._attn_res_source_logits(partial, queries[-1:], eps)[0])
151    _, final_stream = native._softmax_mix(logits, list(final_sources))
152    final_stream = native._activation_boundary(native._batch_reshard(final_stream.astype(embedding.dtype)))
153    return model.final_norm(final_stream), ForwardCapture(
154        token_rows,
155        bigram_ids,
156        bigram_rows,
157        embedding,
158        bigram_source,
159        tuple(captures),
160        final_sources,
161        final_stream,
162        tuple(shared_preactivations),
163        segments,
164        tuple(routing_selected),
165        tuple(routing_weights),
166        tuple(routing_logits),
167        tuple(routed_inputs),
168    )

32def steady_calls(executable, arguments, repeats):
33    """Time repeated synchronized calls after compilation and warmup."""
34    durations = []
35    for _ in range(repeats):
36        began = time.perf_counter()
37        output = executable(*arguments)
38        jax.block_until_ready(output)
39        durations.append(time.perf_counter() - began)
40    return output, durations
41

43def native_forward(model, tokens, mask):

47def capture_hidden_only(model, tokens, mask):
48    return capture_forward(model, tokens, mask)[0]
49 
50 
51def native_with_routing(model, tokens, mask):
52    hidden, metrics = model(tokens, mask, return_routing=True)
53    return hidden, metrics[SHARED_PRE_KEY], metrics[ROUTING_SELECTED_KEY]

62        reduction="mean",

68def main():
69    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
70    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, required=True)
71    parser.add_argument("--sequence", type=int, required=True)
72    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, required=True)
73    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
74    parser.add_argument("--measure-backward", action="store_true")
75    parser.add_argument("--measure-boost", action="store_true")
76    args = parser.parse_args()
77    if args.repeats < 1:
78        raise ValueError("At least one synchronized timing repeat is required")
79    manifest = load_probe_manifest()

81    devices = jax.devices()

83        raise ValueError("This probe requires exactly eight GPUs")
84    if args.batch % 8 or args.sequence % 32 or args.sequence > cfg.max_seq_len:
85        raise ValueError("Batch must divide over eight GPUs; sequence must fit and align to KDA chunks")
86    mesh = Mesh(
87        np.asarray(devices).reshape(1, 1, 8, 1),
88        ("replica_dcn", "data", "expert", "model"),
89        axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * 4,
90    )
91    result = {
92        "kind": "synthetic_forward_parity_probe",
93        "manifest": manifest,
94        "batch": args.batch,
95        "sequence": args.sequence,
96        "devices": [device.device_kind for device in devices],
97        "jax_version": jax.__version__,
98        "repeats": args.repeats,
99        "backward_control_benchmark": args.measure_backward,
100        "boost_hub_benchmark": args.measure_boost,
101        "xla_flags": os.environ.get("XLA_FLAGS", ""),
102    }
103    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
104    started = time.perf_counter()
105    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
106        model = eqx.filter_jit(Transformer.init)(cfg, key=jax.random.PRNGKey(0))
107        jax.block_until_ready(model)
108        result["initialization_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
109        result["parameter_count"] = sum(x.size for x in jax.tree.leaves(model) if eqx.is_array(x))
110        if result["parameter_count"] != 1_026_488_855:
111            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected parameter count: {result['parameter_count']}")
112        master_model = model
113        model = jmp.get_policy("bf16").cast_to_compute(model)
114        shape = (args.batch, args.sequence)
115        token_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(("replica_dcn", "data", "expert"), None))
116        rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
117        tokens = jax.device_put(rng.integers(0, cfg.vocab_size, shape, dtype=np.int32), token_sharding)
118        segments = jax.device_put(
119            np.broadcast_to(np.arange(args.sequence, dtype=np.int32) // (args.sequence // 2), shape),
120            token_sharding,
121        )
122        mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, segment_ids=(segments, segments))
123        outputs = []
124        diagnostics = {}
125        for name, function in (
126            ("native", native_forward),
127            ("capture", capture_forward),
128            ("capture_hidden_only", capture_hidden_only),
129            ("native_with_routing", native_with_routing),
130        ):
131            compiled = eqx.filter_jit(function)
132            begin = time.perf_counter()

134            output = executable(model, tokens, mask)
135            jax.block_until_ready(output)
136            result[f"{name}_first_call_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - begin
137            if name in ("native", "capture"):
138                (args.output.parent / f"{name}-optimized-hlo.txt").write_text(executable.compiled.as_text())
139            output, times = steady_calls(executable, (model, tokens, mask), args.repeats)
140            result[f"{name}_steady_seconds"] = times
141            result["last_completed_stage"] = name

143            hidden = output if name in ("native", "capture_hidden_only") else output[0]

145            if name == "capture":
146                capture = output[1]

148                diagnostics["capture_selected"] = [np.asarray(x) for x in output[1].routing_selected]
149            elif name == "native_with_routing":
150                diagnostics["native_shared"] = np.asarray(output[1], np.float32)
151                diagnostics["native_selected"] = np.asarray(output[2])
152            print(
153                json.dumps(
154                    {
155                        "stage": name,
156                        "first_call_seconds": result[f"{name}_first_call_seconds"],
157                    }
158                ),
159                flush=True,
160            )
161        result["diagnostic_hidden_errors"] = {
162            name: {
163                "max": float(np.abs(value - outputs[0]).max()),
164                "mean": float(np.abs(value - outputs[0]).mean()),
165            }
166            for name, value in zip(
167                ("capture", "capture_hidden_only", "native_with_routing"),
168                outputs[1:],
169                strict=True,
170            )
171        }
172        result["shared_pre_error_per_layer"] = [
173            float(np.abs(a - b).max())
174            for a, b in zip(diagnostics["capture_shared"], diagnostics["native_shared"], strict=True)
175        ]
176        result["route_mismatch_fraction_per_layer"] = [
177            float(np.mean(a != b))
178            for a, b in zip(
179                diagnostics["capture_selected"],
180                diagnostics["native_selected"],
181                strict=True,
182            )
183        ]
184        difference = np.abs(outputs[0] - outputs[1])
185        result["max_absolute_error"] = float(difference.max())
186        result["mean_absolute_error"] = float(difference.mean())
187        if args.measure_backward:
188            np.testing.assert_allclose(outputs[1], outputs[0], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
189            weights = jax.device_put(
190                np.broadcast_to(
191                    (np.arange(args.sequence) % (args.sequence // 2) != args.sequence // 2 - 1).astype(np.float32),
192                    shape,
193                ),
194                token_sharding,

4"""BF16 capture screening for the bounded Belay component record.
5 
6These engineering thresholds are not a claim of gradient or trajectory equality.
7They replace the agent-selected elementwise 1e-5 GPU gate with user authorization.
8CPU mathematical component tests retain their original tolerances.
9"""
10 
11import equinox as eqx
12import jax
13import jax.numpy as jnp
14 
15from experiments.grug.fast_track import model as native
16 
17MAX_RELATIVE_RMS = 0.005
18MAX_MEAN_LOSS_CHANGE = 0.001
19MAX_ROUTE_DISAGREEMENT = 0.001
20 
21 
22@eqx.filter_jit
23def hidden_loss(model, hidden, tokens, weights):
24    head_input, head = model._lm_head_operands(hidden, tokens)
25    labels = jnp.pad(tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1))).astype(jnp.int32)
26    return native.fused_linear_softmax_cross_entropy_loss(
27        head_input,
28        head,
29        labels,
30        weight=weights,
31        reduction="mean",
32        logsumexp_weight=None,
33        dtype=jnp.float32,
34        implementation="xla_fast_bwd",
35        block_sizes=native._CE_BLOCK_SIZES,
36        logit_soft_cap=native._logit_cap(model.config),
37    )

40@jax.jit
41def activation_errors(actual, expected):
42    a, b = actual.astype(jnp.float32), expected.astype(jnp.float32)
43    delta = a - b
44    return {
45        "finite": jnp.all(jnp.isfinite(a)) & jnp.all(jnp.isfinite(b)),
46        "relative_rms": jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(delta**2)) / jnp.maximum(jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(b**2)), 1e-12),
47        "max_absolute": jnp.max(jnp.abs(delta)),
48        "mean_absolute": jnp.mean(jnp.abs(delta)),
49        "old_fraction_outside_1e5": jnp.mean(jnp.abs(delta) > 1e-5 + 1e-5 * jnp.abs(b)),
50    }
51 
52 
53def capture_screen(model, actual, expected, tokens, weights, selected, reference_selected):
54    diagnostics = {k: float(v) for k, v in activation_errors(actual, expected).items()}
55    diagnostics["finite"] = bool(diagnostics["finite"])
56    native_loss = float(hidden_loss(model, expected, tokens, weights))
57    captured_loss = float(hidden_loss(model, actual, tokens, weights))
58    route_errors = [float(jnp.mean(a != b)) for a, b in zip(selected, reference_selected, strict=True)]
59    diagnostics.update(
60        native_cross_entropy=native_loss,
61        captured_cross_entropy=captured_loss,
62        mean_cross_entropy_difference=captured_loss - native_loss,
63        route_slot_disagreement_per_layer=route_errors,
64        thresholds={
65            "relative_rms": MAX_RELATIVE_RMS,
66            "absolute_mean_cross_entropy_difference": MAX_MEAN_LOSS_CHANGE,
67            "maximum_layer_route_slot_disagreement": MAX_ROUTE_DISAGREEMENT,
68        },
69        scope="BF16 component screening only; not equality of updates or learning trajectories",
70        user_authorized_relaxation=True,
71    )
72    diagnostics["passed"] = bool(
73        diagnostics["finite"]
74        and diagnostics["relative_rms"] <= MAX_RELATIVE_RMS
75        and abs(captured_loss - native_loss) <= MAX_MEAN_LOSS_CHANGE
76        and max(route_errors) <= MAX_ROUTE_DISAGREEMENT
77    )
78    return diagnostics

4"""Forward-loss probe primitives for the candidate 11 port of Noise.
5 
6These are building blocks, not a complete Boost/Cut estimator. No autodiff is
7used. The rectangular direction frame supports Belay's non-power-of-two widths.
8"""
9 
10from collections.abc import Callable
11from typing import NamedTuple
12 
13import jax
14import jax.numpy as jnp
15import numpy as np
16from scipy.linalg import hadamard
17 
18PROBE_RMS_FLOOR = 1e-6
19 
20 
21def direction_frame(width: int, key: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
22    """Return a signed frame H with H.T @ H = order * I.
23 
24    At power-of-two widths this is Noise's full Hadamard cycle. At other
25    widths, retain the first width columns of the next larger cycle. The
26    decoder must divide by the number of rows, not the model width.
27    """
28    order = 1 << (width - 1).bit_length()
29    frame = jnp.asarray(hadamard(order, dtype=np.int8)[:, :width], jnp.float32)
30    signs = jax.random.rademacher(key, (width,), dtype=jnp.float32)
31    return frame * signs
32 
33 
34def token_readout_credit(
35    loss: Callable[[jax.Array], jax.Array],
36    point: jax.Array,
37    directions: jax.Array,
38    *,
39    relative_step: float,
40    chunk_size: int,
41) -> jax.Array:
42    """Measure local readout credit by a full cycle of central forward probes.
43 
44    ``loss`` maps [tokens, width] to [tokens] and must not mix tokens. This
45    function is not a probe of a sequence mixer such as KDA or attention.
46    """
47    point = point.astype(jnp.float32)
48    count = directions.shape[0]
49    step = relative_step * jnp.maximum(jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(point**2, axis=-1)), PROBE_RMS_FLOOR)
50    padding = (-count) % chunk_size
51    chunks = jnp.pad(directions, ((0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(-1, chunk_size, point.shape[-1])
52 
53    def probe(total, rows):
54        moves = rows[:, None, :] * step[None, :, None]
55        upper = jax.vmap(loss)(point[None, :, :] + moves)
56        lower = jax.vmap(loss)(point[None, :, :] - moves)
57        slopes = (upper - lower) / (2 * step[None, :])
58        return total + slopes.T @ rows / count, None
59 
60    credit, _ = jax.lax.scan(probe, jnp.zeros_like(point), chunks)
61    return credit
62 
63 
64def head_coordinate_credit(
65    raw_logits: jax.Array,
66    labels: jax.Array,
67    *,
68    sigma: float,
69    soft_cap: float,
70    z_loss_weight: float,
71) -> jax.Array:
72    """Evaluate coordinate finite differences of capped CE plus Belay's z-loss.
73 
74    Updating one logit changes only one term of the partition function, so
75    these are exact moved forward losses without materializing a vocabulary
76    squared tensor. Labels below zero denote ignored positions.
77    """
78    raw = raw_logits.astype(jnp.float32)
79    capped = soft_cap * jnp.tanh(raw / soft_cap)
80    upper = soft_cap * jnp.tanh((raw + sigma) / soft_cap)
81    lower = soft_cap * jnp.tanh((raw - sigma) / soft_cap)
82    log_partition = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(capped, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
83    probability = jnp.exp(capped - log_partition)
84 
85    def moved_loss(moved):
86        change = jnp.log1p(probability * jnp.expm1(moved - capped))
87        return change + z_loss_weight * change * (2 * log_partition + change)
88 
89    change = moved_loss(upper) - moved_loss(lower)
90    target = jax.nn.one_hot(jnp.maximum(labels, 0), raw.shape[-1])
91    change = change - target * (upper - lower)
92    return jnp.where(labels[..., None] >= 0, change / (2 * sigma), 0)
93 
94 
95def capped_token_loss(raw_logits: jax.Array, labels: jax.Array, soft_cap: float, z_loss_weight: float) -> jax.Array:
96    capped = soft_cap * jnp.tanh(raw_logits / soft_cap)
97    partition = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(capped, axis=-1)
98    target = jnp.take_along_axis(capped, jnp.maximum(labels, 0)[..., None], axis=-1)[..., 0]
99    return jnp.where(labels >= 0, partition - target + z_loss_weight * partition**2, 0)
100 
101 
102def attnres_readout_credit(
103    partial: jax.Array,
104    fixed_sources: jax.Array,
105    query: jax.Array,
106    head: jax.Array,
107    norm_gain: jax.Array,
108    labels: jax.Array,
109    directions: jax.Array,
110    *,
111    relative_step: float,
112    chunk_size: int,
113    epsilon: float,
114    soft_cap: float,
115    z_loss_weight: float,
116) -> jax.Array:
117    """Probe the candidate 11 depth-attention readout without repeated head GEMMs.
118 
119    Inputs are one token tile: partial [T,D], fixed sources [N,T,D], head
120    [D,V], and directions [K,D]. Every probe recomputes depth attention, final
121    RMS normalization, capped cross entropy and z-loss by forward evaluation.
122    Linear head projections and dot products are shared across the probes.
123    """
124    partial, sources = partial.astype(jnp.float32), fixed_sources.astype(jnp.float32)
125    query, head = query.astype(jnp.float32), head.astype(jnp.float32)
126    width = partial.shape[-1]
127    fixed_logits = jnp.einsum("ntd,d->nt", sources, query) * jax.lax.rsqrt(jnp.mean(sources**2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
128    fixed_partition = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(fixed_logits, axis=0)
129    fixed = jnp.einsum("nt,ntd->td", jax.nn.softmax(fixed_logits, axis=0), sources)
130    weighted_head = norm_gain.astype(jnp.float32)[:, None] * head
131    fixed_head, partial_head = fixed @ weighted_head, partial @ weighted_head
132    partial_square = jnp.sum(partial**2, axis=-1)
133    partial_query = partial @ query
134    partial_norm = jnp.sqrt(partial_square / width + epsilon)
135    partial_logit = partial_query / partial_norm
136    clean_weight = jax.nn.sigmoid(partial_logit - fixed_partition)
137    clean_mix = (1 - clean_weight)[:, None] * fixed + clean_weight[:, None] * partial
138    clean_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(clean_mix**2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
139    clean_head = (1 - clean_weight)[:, None] * fixed_head + clean_weight[:, None] * partial_head
140    clean_raw = clean_head / clean_norm[:, None]
141    clean_tanh = jnp.tanh(clean_raw / soft_cap)
142    clean_capped = soft_cap * clean_tanh
143    clean_partition = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(clean_capped, axis=-1)
144    clean_probability = jax.nn.softmax(clean_capped, axis=-1)
145    step = relative_step * jnp.maximum(jnp.sqrt(partial_square / width), PROBE_RMS_FLOOR)
146    count = directions.shape[0]
147    padding = (-count) % chunk_size
148    chunks = jnp.pad(directions, ((0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(-1, chunk_size, width)
149 
150    def probe(total, rows):
151        row_head = rows @ weighted_head
152        row_query = rows @ query
153 
154        def loss_changes(sign):
155            displacement = sign * step[:, None]
156            move = displacement[..., None] * rows[None, :, :]
157            moved_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean((partial[:, None, :] + move) ** 2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
158            norm_change = jnp.mean(2 * partial[:, None, :] * move + move**2, axis=-1)
159            inverse_change = -norm_change / (moved_norm * partial_norm[:, None] * (moved_norm + partial_norm[:, None]))
160            logit_change = displacement * row_query / moved_norm + partial_query[:, None] * inverse_change
161            half_tanh = jnp.tanh(logit_change / 2)
162            alpha = clean_weight[:, None]
163            alpha_change = 2 * alpha * (1 - alpha) * half_tanh / (1 + (2 * alpha - 1) * half_tanh)
164            moved_alpha = alpha + alpha_change
165            mix_move = alpha_change[..., None] * (partial - fixed)[:, None, :] + moved_alpha[..., None] * move
166            mix_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean((clean_mix[:, None, :] + mix_move) ** 2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
167            mix_norm_change = jnp.mean(2 * clean_mix[:, None, :] * mix_move + mix_move**2, axis=-1)
168            mix_inverse_change = -mix_norm_change / (mix_norm * clean_norm[:, None] * (mix_norm + clean_norm[:, None]))
169            head_move = (
170                alpha_change[..., None] * (partial_head - fixed_head)[:, None, :]
171                + moved_alpha[..., None] * displacement[..., None] * row_head[None, :, :]
172            )
173            raw_change = head_move / mix_norm[..., None] + clean_head[:, None, :] * mix_inverse_change[..., None]
174            # Evaluate tanh(z + delta) - tanh(z) without subtracting nearby logits.
175            tanh_move = jnp.tanh(raw_change / soft_cap)
176            capped_change = (
177                soft_cap * tanh_move * (1 - clean_tanh[:, None, :] ** 2) / (1 + clean_tanh[:, None, :] * tanh_move)
178            )
179            partition_change = jnp.log1p(jnp.sum(clean_probability[:, None, :] * jnp.expm1(capped_change), axis=-1))
180            target = jnp.broadcast_to(jnp.maximum(labels, 0)[:, None, None], (*partition_change.shape, 1))
181            target_change = jnp.take_along_axis(capped_change, target, axis=-1)[..., 0]
182            change = (
183                partition_change
184                - target_change
185                + z_loss_weight * partition_change * (2 * clean_partition[:, None] + partition_change)
186            )
187            return jnp.where(labels[:, None] >= 0, change, 0)
188 
189        slopes = (loss_changes(1) - loss_changes(-1)) / (2 * step[:, None])
190        return total + slopes @ rows / count, None
191 
192    credit, _ = jax.lax.scan(probe, jnp.zeros_like(partial), chunks)
193    return credit

202def capped_loss_change(
203    clean_raw: jax.Array,
204    raw_change: jax.Array,
205    labels: jax.Array,
206    *,
207    soft_cap: float,
208    z_loss_weight: float,
209) -> jax.Array:
210    """Evaluate a finite readout loss change without subtracting nearby losses.
211 
212    The first dimensions broadcast: callers insert a probe dimension into
213    ``clean_raw`` and ``labels`` when evaluating several moves together.
214    """
215    clean_tanh = jnp.tanh(clean_raw / soft_cap)
216    clean_capped = soft_cap * clean_tanh
217    partition = jax.scipy.special.logsumexp(clean_capped, axis=-1)
218    probability = jax.nn.softmax(clean_capped, axis=-1)
219    tanh_move = jnp.tanh(raw_change / soft_cap)
220    capped_change = soft_cap * tanh_move * (1 - clean_tanh**2) / (1 + clean_tanh * tanh_move)
221    partition_change = jnp.log1p(jnp.sum(probability * jnp.expm1(capped_change), axis=-1))
222    target = jnp.broadcast_to(jnp.maximum(labels, 0)[..., None], (*partition_change.shape, 1))
223    target_change = jnp.take_along_axis(capped_change, target, axis=-1)[..., 0]
224    loss_change = (
225        partition_change - target_change + z_loss_weight * partition_change * (2 * partition + partition_change)
226    )
227    return jnp.where(labels >= 0, loss_change, 0)
228 
229 
230def readout_parameter_credit(
231    sources: jax.Array,
232    query: jax.Array,
233    head: jax.Array,
234    norm_gain: jax.Array,
235    labels: jax.Array,
236    loss_weight: jax.Array,
237    directions: jax.Array,
238    *,
239    head_step: float,
240    query_step: float,
241    direction_chunk: int,
242    epsilon: float,
243    soft_cap: float,
244    z_loss_weight: float,
245) -> ReadoutParameterCredit:
246    """Measure shared readout parameter updates on a token tile, without AD.
247 
248    ``sources`` has shape [sources, tokens, width]. Head and learned RMS gain
249    updates transport directly measured logit credit through linear maps.
250    The depth query uses its own complete finite forward-loss cycle through
251    depth mixing, final normalization, head and capped loss. Query moves use
252    an absolute step because candidate 11 initializes this query at zero.
253    Returns unnormalized weighted sums; the caller owns batch normalization.
254    """
255    sources, query, head, gain = (array.astype(jnp.float32) for array in (sources, query, head, norm_gain))
256    normalized_sources = sources * jax.lax.rsqrt(jnp.mean(sources**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + epsilon)
257    logits = normalized_sources @ query
258    weights = jax.nn.softmax(logits, axis=0)
259    mixed = jnp.sum(weights[..., None] * sources, axis=0)
260    norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(mixed**2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
261    normalized = mixed / norm[:, None]
262    hidden = normalized * gain
263    clean_head = (mixed * gain) @ head
264    raw = clean_head / norm[:, None]
265    logit_credit = (
266        head_coordinate_credit(raw, labels, sigma=head_step, soft_cap=soft_cap, z_loss_weight=z_loss_weight)
267        * loss_weight[:, None]
268    )
269    head_credit = hidden.T @ logit_credit
270    gain_credit = jnp.sum(normalized * (logit_credit @ head.T), axis=0)
271    count, width = directions.shape
272    padding = (-count) % direction_chunk
273    chunks = jnp.pad(directions, ((0, padding), (0, 0))).reshape(-1, direction_chunk, width)
274 
275    def probe(total, rows):
276        logit_moves = query_step * jnp.einsum("ntd,kd->ntk", normalized_sources, rows)
277 
278        def loss_changes(sign):
279            exp_change = jnp.expm1(sign * logit_moves)
280            partition_change = jnp.sum(weights[..., None] * exp_change, axis=0)
281            weight_change = weights[..., None] * (exp_change - partition_change[None]) / (1 + partition_change[None])
282            mix_change = jnp.einsum("ntk,ntd->tkd", weight_change, sources)
283            moved_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean((mixed[:, None] + mix_change) ** 2, axis=-1) + epsilon)
284            square_change = jnp.mean(2 * mixed[:, None] * mix_change + mix_change**2, axis=-1)
285            inverse_change = -square_change / (moved_norm * norm[:, None] * (moved_norm + norm[:, None]))
286            raw_change = (mix_change * gain) @ head / moved_norm[..., None] + clean_head[:, None] * inverse_change[
287                ..., None
288            ]
289            return capped_loss_change(
290                raw[:, None],
291                raw_change,
292                labels[:, None],
293                soft_cap=soft_cap,
294                z_loss_weight=z_loss_weight,
295            )
296 
297        slopes = (loss_changes(1) - loss_changes(-1)) / (2 * query_step)
298        return (
299            total + jnp.sum(slopes * loss_weight[:, None], axis=0) @ rows / count,
300            None,
301        )
302 
303    query_credit, _ = jax.lax.scan(probe, jnp.zeros_like(query), chunks)
304    return ReadoutParameterCredit(head_credit, gain_credit, query_credit)

309    down: jax.Array

312def relu2_parameter_credit(
313    inputs: jax.Array,
314    preactivation: jax.Array,
315    output_weight: jax.Array,
316    output_credit: jax.Array,
317    *,
318    relative_step: float,
319) -> Relu2ParameterCredit:
320    """Reconstruct an ungated ReLU-squared expert's two matrix updates.
321 
322    The caller supplies independently measured output credit, already weighted
323    by the objective. The hidden response is Noise's collapsed full central
324    Hadamard cycle, retaining finite-step ReLU crossings. It must not be reused
325    as credit through a further nonlinear operation. Return unnormalized sums.
326    """
327    # Preserve the clean forward's activation rounding for its linear readout.
328    hidden = jnp.square(jax.nn.relu(preactivation))
329    if preactivation.dtype == jnp.bfloat16:
330        # A cast alone can be removed when XLA fuses this with the f32 readout.
331        hidden = jax.lax.reduce_precision(hidden.astype(jnp.float32), exponent_bits=8, mantissa_bits=7)
332    hidden = hidden.astype(jnp.float32)
333    inputs = inputs.astype(jnp.float32)
334    point = preactivation.astype(jnp.float32)
335    weight = output_weight.astype(jnp.float32)
336    credit = output_credit.astype(jnp.float32)
337    step = relative_step * jnp.maximum(jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(point**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)), PROBE_RMS_FLOOR)
338    upper = jax.nn.relu(point + step)
339    # Exact piecewise central difference: avoid subtracting nearby positive
340    # preactivations, which loses precision at small finite probe steps.
341    finite_slope = jnp.where(point >= step, 2 * point, upper**2 / (2 * step))
342    hidden_credit = (credit @ weight.T) * finite_slope
343    return Relu2ParameterCredit(inputs.T @ hidden_credit, hidden.T @ credit)
344 
345 
346def causal_convolution_credit(
347    output_credit: jax.Array,
348    weight: jax.Array,
349    segment_ids: jax.Array | None,
350) -> jax.Array:
351    """Transport measured credit through a fixed linear causal convolution.
352 
353    This is an exact linear contraction, with future responses restricted to
354    the same packed document. It neither estimates a nonlinear derivative nor
355    invokes the model's backward kernels.
356    """
357    credit = output_credit.astype(jnp.float32)
358    weight = weight.astype(jnp.float32)
359    result = jnp.zeros_like(credit)
360    length = credit.shape[1]
361    for lag in range(min(weight.shape[0], length)):
362        term = credit[:, lag:] * weight[lag]
363        if segment_ids is not None:
364            valid = segment_ids[:, lag:] == segment_ids[:, : length - lag]
365            term = jnp.where(valid[..., None], term, 0)
366        result = result + jnp.pad(term, ((0, 0), (0, lag), (0, 0)))
367    return result
368 
369 
370def causal_convolution_parameter_credit(
371    inputs: jax.Array,
372    output_credit: jax.Array,
373    segment_ids: jax.Array | None,
374    *,
375    kernel_size: int,
376) -> jax.Array:
377    """Contract independent output credit into causal depthwise kernel weights.
378 
379    Inputs and credits are [batch, sequence, channels]. Packed-document edges
380    stop each lag, matching native ShortConv. Return unnormalized [lag, channel]
381    sums; the caller combines sums across batch shards.
382    """
383    inputs = inputs.astype(jnp.float32)
384    credit = output_credit.astype(jnp.float32)
385    length = inputs.shape[1]
386    rows = []
387    for lag in range(kernel_size):
388        if lag >= length:
389            rows.append(jnp.zeros((inputs.shape[-1],), jnp.float32))
390            continue
391        term = inputs[:, : length - lag] * credit[:, lag:]
392        if segment_ids is not None:
393            valid = segment_ids[:, lag:] == segment_ids[:, : length - lag]
394            term = jnp.where(valid[..., None], term, 0)
395        rows.append(jnp.sum(term, axis=(0, 1)))
396    return jnp.stack(rows)
397

399def sqrt_softplus_router_credit(
400    logits: jax.Array,
401    expert_scores: jax.Array,
402    kept: jax.Array,
403    *,
404    sigma: float,
405    renorm_sum: float,
406) -> jax.Array:
407    """Measure selected-router logits through the original measured output hub.
408 
409    All arguments have shape [tokens, selected experts]. ``expert_scores`` is
410    each frozen expert output contracted with independently measured hub credit.
411    Each coordinate gets its own positive/negative forward probe. Selection and
412    capacity masks stay fixed, while sqrt-softplus combine weights and native
413    post-drop renormalization are recomputed. Return unnormalized token credits.
414    """
415    logits = logits.astype(jnp.float32)
416    scores = expert_scores.astype(jnp.float32)
417    softplus = jax.nn.softplus(logits)
418    mass = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(softplus, 1e-30))
419    total = jnp.sum(mass, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
420    surviving = jnp.sum(jnp.where(kept, mass, 0), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
421    numerator = jnp.sum(jnp.where(kept, mass * scores, 0), axis=-1, keepdims=True)
422    average = numerator / jnp.where(surviving > 0, surviving, 1)
423    scale = renorm_sum * total / (total + 1e-9)
424 
425    def moved_loss_change(step):
426        # log(1 + exp(x + step)) - log(1 + exp(x)), evaluated stably.
427        softplus_change = jnp.log1p(jax.nn.sigmoid(logits) * jnp.expm1(step))
428        moved = jnp.maximum(softplus + softplus_change, 1e-30)
429        change = jnp.where(
430            (softplus > 1e-30) & (softplus + softplus_change > 1e-30),
431            softplus_change,
432            moved - jnp.maximum(softplus, 1e-30),
433        ) / (jnp.sqrt(moved) + mass)
434        average_change = jnp.where(
435            kept,
436            change * (scores - average) / jnp.where(kept, surviving + change, 1),
437            0,
438        )
439        scale_change = renorm_sum * 1e-9 * change / ((total + 1e-9) * (total + change + 1e-9))
440        return scale * average_change + scale_change * (average + average_change)
441 
442    return (moved_loss_change(sigma) - moved_loss_change(-sigma)) / (2 * sigma)

56    sender_keep = pool_ranks < pool_capacity
57    dispatch, _ = _dispatch_pooled(
