78def pooled_relu2_parameter_credit(
79    inputs: jax.Array,
80    selected_experts: jax.Array,
81    combine_weights: jax.Array,
82    up: jax.Array,
83    down: jax.Array,
84    output_credit: jax.Array,
85    *,
86    capacity_factor: float,
87    transport_capacity_factor: float,
88    relative_step: float,
89) -> Relu2ParameterCredit:
90    """Reconstruct matrices with fixed routing and native drop renormalization.
91 
92    Inputs and credits have shape [tokens, channels], routing arrays [tokens, K],
93    and matrices [experts, input, hidden] / [experts, hidden, output]. The credit
94    must come from an independent measured hub. Only fixed linear dispatch,
95    combine and readout operations transport it before a single finite ReLU²
96    probe; no corrected credit is propagated through another nonlinearity.
97 
98    This covers candidate 11's one-wave, non-FP8 dispatch with all tokens valid.
99    Loss-masked tokens still participate in routing, as in its native forward.
100    Credits are unnormalized sums. Router and latent-normalization parameters
101    require separate independent probes.
102    """
103    num_experts = up.shape[0]
104 
105    def local(x, selected, weights, up, down, credit):
106        tokens, topk = selected.shape
107        local_experts = up.shape[0]
108        assignments = tokens * topk
109        dispatch, keep, shards, pool_capacity, receiver_capacity = _local_route(
110            x,
111            selected,
112            local_experts=local_experts,
113            shards=num_experts // local_experts,
114            capacity_factor=capacity_factor,
115            transport_capacity_factor=transport_capacity_factor,
116        )
117        # Native MoE rounds combine weights to compute precision but calculates
118        # its post-drop renormalization from the original float32 weights.
119        kept_sum = jnp.sum(jnp.where(keep, weights, 0), axis=-1)
120        renormalize = jnp.any(~keep, axis=-1) & (kept_sum > 0)
121        scale = (
122            jnp.where(
123                renormalize,
124                jnp.sum(weights, axis=-1) / jnp.where(renormalize, kept_sum, 1),
125                1,
126            )
127            .astype(x.dtype)
128            .astype(jnp.float32)
129        )
130        credit = credit.astype(jnp.float32) * scale[:, None]
131        valid = dispatch.assignment_sources < assignments
132        source = jnp.minimum(dispatch.assignment_sources, assignments - 1)
133        source_weight = weights.astype(x.dtype).reshape(-1)[source].astype(jnp.float32)
134        sent_credit = jnp.where(valid[:, None], credit[source // topk] * source_weight[:, None], 0)
135        received_credit = jax.lax.all_to_all(
136            sent_credit.reshape(shards, pool_capacity, credit.shape[-1]),
137            "expert",
138            split_axis=0,
139            concat_axis=0,
140            tiled=True,
141        ).reshape(-1, credit.shape[-1])
142        expert_credit = _compact_received(
143            received_credit,
144            dispatch.receiver_linear_indices,
145            dispatch.receiver_keep,
146            local_experts,
147            receiver_capacity,
148        )
149        preactivation = jnp.einsum("erh,ehi->eri", dispatch.compacted_x, up)
150        result = jax.vmap(partial(relu2_parameter_credit, relative_step=relative_step))(
151            dispatch.compacted_x, preactivation, down, expert_credit
152        )
153        return jax.tree.map(lambda value: jax.lax.psum(value, ("replica_dcn", "data")), result)
154 
155    specs = (
156        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
157        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
158        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
159        P("expert", None, None),
160        P("expert", None, None),
161        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
162    )
163    mapped = jax.shard_map(
164        local,
165        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
166        in_specs=specs,
167        out_specs=Relu2ParameterCredit(P("expert", None, None), P("expert", None, None)),
168        check_vma=False,
169    )
170    return mapped(
171        *(
172            jax.sharding.reshard(value, spec)
173            for value, spec in zip(
174                (inputs, selected_experts, combine_weights, up, down, output_credit),
175                specs,
176                strict=True,
177            )
178        )
179    )
180

182def pooled_router_parameter_credit(
183    inputs: jax.Array,
184    selected_experts: jax.Array,
185    selected_logits: jax.Array,
186    up: jax.Array,
187    down: jax.Array,
188    output_credit: jax.Array,
189    router_inputs: jax.Array,
190    *,
191    capacity_factor: float,
192    transport_capacity_factor: float,
193    sigma: float,
194    renorm_sum: float,
195) -> jax.Array:
196    """Measure fixed-selection router matrix credit through frozen expert outputs.
197 
198    This probes float32 combine weights; the native compute-precision weight
199    cast is treated as an identity, as for Noise's mixed-precision local probes.
200    Capacity and expert selection are frozen at the clean forward. Every logit
201    probe is contracted with the original independently measured MLP hub credit.
202    """
203    num_experts = up.shape[0]
204 
205    def local(x, selected, logits, up, down, credit, router_x):
206        route = _local_route(
207            x,
208            selected,
209            local_experts=up.shape[0],
210            shards=num_experts // up.shape[0],
211            capacity_factor=capacity_factor,
212            transport_capacity_factor=transport_capacity_factor,
213        )
214        dispatch = route.dispatch
215        output = _compute_pooled(
216            dispatch,
217            moe_w13_local=up,
218            moe_w2_local=down,
219            activation_fn=lambda h: jnp.square(jax.nn.relu(h)),
220        )
221        received = _expand_compacted(
222            output.compacted_output,
223            dispatch.receiver_linear_indices,
224            dispatch.receiver_keep,
225        )
226        returned = jax.lax.all_to_all(
227            received.reshape(route.shards, route.pool_capacity, down.shape[-1]),
228            "expert",
229            split_axis=0,
230            concat_axis=0,
231            tiled=True,
232        ).reshape(-1, down.shape[-1])
233        per_assignment = returned[jnp.minimum(dispatch.sender_linear_indices, returned.shape[0] - 1)]
234        per_assignment = per_assignment.reshape(*selected.shape, down.shape[-1])
235        scores = jnp.sum(per_assignment.astype(jnp.float32) * credit[:, None, :], axis=-1)
236        logit_credit = sqrt_softplus_router_credit(
237            logits,
238            scores,
239            route.kept,
240            sigma=sigma,
241            renorm_sum=renorm_sum,
242        )
243        dense_credit = (
244            jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], num_experts), jnp.float32)
245            .at[jnp.arange(x.shape[0])[:, None], selected]
246            .add(logit_credit)
247        )
248        return jax.lax.psum(router_x.astype(jnp.float32).T @ dense_credit, BATCH_AXES)
249 
250    specs = (
251        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
252        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
253        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
254        P("expert", None, None),
255        P("expert", None, None),
256        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
257        P(BATCH_AXES, None),
258    )
259    mapped = jax.shard_map(
260        local,
261        mesh=jax.sharding.get_abstract_mesh(),
262        in_specs=specs,
263        out_specs=P(None, None),
264        check_vma=False,
265    )
266    return mapped(
267        *(
268            jax.sharding.reshard(value, spec)
269            for value, spec in zip(
270                (
271                    inputs,
272                    selected_experts,
273                    selected_logits,
274                    up,
275                    down,
276                    output_credit,
277                    router_inputs,
278                ),
279                specs,
280                strict=True,
281            )
282        )
283    )

97def test_boost_final_hub_matches_native_readout_probes(model_and_mesh):
98    model, mesh = model_and_mesh
99    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
100        tokens = jax.random.randint(jax.random.PRNGKey(7), (2, 128), 0, 128)
101        mask = AttentionMask.causal()
102        _, capture = eqx.filter_jit(capture_forward)(model, tokens, mask)
103        weights = jnp.ones(tokens.shape).at[:, -1].set(0).at[0, 3].set(0.5)
104        key = jax.random.PRNGKey(4)
105        actual = eqx.filter_jit(measure_boost_hubs)(
106            capture.stages,
107            tokens,
108            weights,
109            key,
110            head=model.output_proj,
111            norm_gain=model.final_norm.weight,
112            query=model.attn_res_query_final,
113            epsilon=model.config.layer_norm_eps,
114            soft_cap=model.config.logit_soft_cap,
115            relative_step=0.005,
116            token_chunk=37,
117            direction_chunk=7,
118            z_loss_weight=0.0001,
119        )[-1]
120        labels = jnp.pad(tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1)))
121        labels = jnp.where(weights > 0, labels, -1)
122        stage = capture.stages[-1]
123 
124        frame = np.asarray(direction_frame(64, jax.random.fold_in(key, len(capture.stages) - 1)))
125    # Full float64 forward evaluations are an independent oracle. Subtracting
126    # float32 losses loses precision for the model's small residual writes.
127    point = np.asarray(stage.partial, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 64)
128    fixed = np.stack([np.asarray(source, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 64) for source in stage.completed_sources])
129    query = np.asarray(model.attn_res_query_final, dtype=np.float64)
130    gain = np.asarray(model.final_norm.weight, dtype=np.float64)
131    head = np.asarray(model.output_proj, dtype=np.float64)
132    target = np.asarray(labels).reshape(-1)
133 
134    def full_readout(moved):
135        sources = np.concatenate([fixed, moved[None]], axis=0)
136        normalized = sources / np.sqrt(np.mean(sources**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5)
137        logits = normalized @ query
138        source_weights = np.exp(logits - logsumexp(logits, axis=0, keepdims=True))
139        mixed = np.sum(source_weights[..., None] * sources, axis=0)
140        hidden = mixed / np.sqrt(np.mean(mixed**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5) * gain
141        capped = 10 * np.tanh((hidden @ head) / 10)
142        partition = logsumexp(capped, axis=-1)
143        loss = partition - capped[np.arange(len(target)), np.maximum(target, 0)] + 0.0001 * partition**2
144        return np.where(target >= 0, loss, 0)
145 
146    step = 0.005 * np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.mean(point**2, axis=-1)), 1e-6)
147    expected = np.zeros_like(point)
148    for row in frame:
149        move = step[:, None] * row
150        slope = (full_readout(point + move) - full_readout(point - move)) / (2 * step)
151        expected += slope[:, None] * row / len(frame)
152    expected = expected.reshape(stage.partial.shape) * np.asarray(weights)[..., None]
153    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)
154

217def test_shared_expert_reconstruction_matches_independent_forward_responses(model_and_mesh, precision):
218    model, mesh = model_and_mesh

224        _, capture = eqx.filter_jit(capture_forward)(model, tokens, mask)
225        hub_credits = []
226        for stage in capture.stages:
227            value = np.zeros(stage.output.shape, np.float32)
228            value[0, :5] = rng.normal(size=(5, 64))

230        actual = eqx.filter_jit(reconstruct_shared_experts)(model, capture, tuple(hub_credits), relative_step=0.05)
231        for index in (0, 5):

233            inputs = layer.mlp_gated_norm(layer.rms_mlp(capture.stages[2 * index + 1].input))
234            inputs = np.asarray(inputs, np.float64).reshape(-1, 64)[:5]
235            pre = capture.shared_preactivations[index][:5]
236            point = np.asarray(pre, np.float64)
237            clean_hidden = np.asarray(jnp.square(jax.nn.relu(pre)), np.float64)
238            weight = np.asarray(layer.shared[0].w_down, np.float64)
239            measured = np.asarray(hub_credits[2 * index + 1], np.float64).reshape(-1, 64)[:5]
240            frame = np.asarray(direction_frame(point.shape[-1], jax.random.PRNGKey(4)), np.float64)
241            steps = 0.05 * np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.mean(point**2, axis=-1)), 1e-6)
242            local_credit = np.zeros_like(point)
243            for row in frame:
244                upper = np.maximum(point + steps[:, None] * row, 0) ** 2 @ weight
245                lower = np.maximum(point - steps[:, None] * row, 0) ** 2 @ weight
246                score = np.sum((upper - lower) * measured, axis=-1) / (2 * steps)
247                local_credit += score[:, None] * row / len(frame)
248            np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[index].up, inputs.T @ local_credit, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)
249            np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[index].down, clean_hidden.T @ measured, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)

27@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [512, 768, 1280])
28def test_readout_cycle_recovers_quadratic_credit_at_belay_widths(width):
29    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
30    point = jnp.asarray(rng.normal(size=(3, width)), dtype=jnp.float32)
31    linear = jnp.asarray(rng.normal(size=(3, width)), dtype=jnp.float32)

34    def loss(value):
35        return jnp.sum(0.5 * value**2 + value * linear, axis=-1) / width

37    # A quadratic's central differences equal its derivatives at any step.
38    # This checks frame decoding, including the non-power-of-two normalization.
39    actual = token_readout_credit(loss, point, frame, relative_step=0.1, chunk_size=37)
40    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, (point + linear) / width, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)

51    def loss(logits, target):

54        return partition - capped[target] + z_loss_weight * partition**2

85    def direct_loss(moved):
86        all_sources = jnp.concatenate([sources, moved[None]], axis=0)
87        keys = all_sources / jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(all_sources**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5)
88        logits = jnp.einsum("ntd,d->nt", keys, query)
89        mixed = jnp.sum(jax.nn.softmax(logits, axis=0)[..., None] * all_sources, axis=0)
90        normalized = mixed / jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(mixed**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5)
91        return capped_token_loss((normalized * gain) @ head, labels, 10.0, 0.0001)

93    expected = token_readout_credit(direct_loss, point, frame, relative_step=0.05, chunk_size=7)

97        query,
98        head,
99        gain,
100        labels,
101        frame,
102        relative_step=0.05,
103        chunk_size=7,
104        epsilon=1e-5,
105        soft_cap=10.0,

111@pytest.mark.parametrize("width,query_scale,source_scale", [(16, 0.0, 1e-3), (24, 0.2, 1.0)])
112def test_readout_parameter_credit_matches_float64_forward_oracle(width, query_scale, source_scale):
113    rng = np.random.default_rng(78)
114    sources = rng.normal(0, source_scale, (4, 5, width))
115    query = rng.normal(0, query_scale, width)
116    head = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (width, 19))
117    gain = rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, width)
118    labels = np.array([0, 18, -1, 4, 7])
119    weights = np.array([1.0, 0.25, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0])
120    directions = direction_frame(width, jax.random.PRNGKey(4))
121    actual = jax.jit(readout_parameter_credit, static_argnames=("direction_chunk",))(
122        jnp.asarray(sources),
123        jnp.asarray(query),
124        jnp.asarray(head),
125        jnp.asarray(gain),
126        jnp.asarray(labels),
127        jnp.asarray(weights),
128        directions,
129        head_step=0.1,
130        query_step=0.005,
131        direction_chunk=7,
132        epsilon=1e-5,
133        soft_cap=10.0,
134        z_loss_weight=0.0001,
135    )
136 
137    def readout(current_query):
138        keys = sources / np.sqrt(np.mean(sources**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5)
139        logits = keys @ current_query
140        source_weights = np.exp(logits - logsumexp(logits, axis=0, keepdims=True))
141        mixed = np.sum(source_weights[..., None] * sources, axis=0)
142        normalized = mixed / np.sqrt(np.mean(mixed**2, axis=-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-5)
143        return normalized, (normalized * gain) @ head
144 
145    def loss(raw):
146        capped = 10 * np.tanh(raw / 10)
147        partition = logsumexp(capped, axis=-1)
148        value = partition - capped[np.arange(5), np.maximum(labels, 0)] + 0.0001 * partition**2
149        return np.where(labels >= 0, value, 0)
150 
151    normalized, raw = readout(query)
152    logit_credit = np.zeros_like(raw)
153    for coordinate in range(19):
154        move = np.zeros_like(raw)
155        move[:, coordinate] = 0.1
156        logit_credit[:, coordinate] = (loss(raw + move) - loss(raw - move)) / 0.2 * weights
157    expected_head = (normalized * gain).T @ logit_credit
158    expected_gain = np.sum(normalized * (logit_credit @ head.T), axis=0)
159    expected_query = np.zeros_like(query)
160    for row in np.asarray(directions, dtype=np.float64):
161        upper = loss(readout(query + 0.005 * row)[1])
162        lower = loss(readout(query - 0.005 * row)[1])
163        expected_query += np.sum((upper - lower) * weights) / 0.01 * row / len(directions)
164    for observed, expected in zip(actual, (expected_head, expected_gain, expected_query), strict=True):
165        np.testing.assert_allclose(observed, expected, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)

168@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [16, 24])
169def test_relu2_parameter_credit_matches_forward_cycle_with_zero_crossings(width):
170    rng = np.random.default_rng(12)
171    inputs = rng.normal(size=(5, 7))
172    preactivation = rng.normal(size=(5, width))
173    # Deliberately cross the kink; replacing finite slopes with derivatives fails.
174    preactivation[:, :3] = [0.0, -0.001, 0.001]
175    preactivation[-1] = 0
176    weight = rng.normal(0, 0.2, (width, 9))
177    credit = rng.normal(size=(5, 9)) * np.array([1, 0, 0.25, 1, 1])[:, None]
178    sigma = 0.05
179    steps = sigma * np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.mean(preactivation**2, axis=-1)), 1e-6)
180    frame = np.asarray(direction_frame(width, jax.random.PRNGKey(6)), np.float64)
181    hidden_credit = np.zeros_like(preactivation)
182    for direction in frame:
183        upper = np.maximum(preactivation + steps[:, None] * direction, 0) ** 2 @ weight
184        lower = np.maximum(preactivation - steps[:, None] * direction, 0) ** 2 @ weight
185        score = np.sum((upper - lower) * credit, axis=-1) / (2 * steps)
186        hidden_credit += score[:, None] * direction / len(frame)
187    expected_up = inputs.T @ hidden_credit
188    # Independent coordinate perturbations of the linear output projection.
189    expected_down = np.zeros_like(weight)
190    hidden = np.maximum(preactivation, 0) ** 2
191    for i in range(width):
192        for j in range(9):
193            move = np.zeros_like(weight)
194            move[i, j] = 0.1
195            upper = np.sum((hidden @ (weight + move)) * credit)
196            lower = np.sum((hidden @ (weight - move)) * credit)
197            expected_down[i, j] = (upper - lower) / 0.2
198    observed = jax.jit(relu2_parameter_credit)(
199        jnp.asarray(inputs),
200        jnp.asarray(preactivation),
201        jnp.asarray(weight),
202        jnp.asarray(credit),
203        relative_step=sigma,
204    )
205    np.testing.assert_allclose(observed.up, expected_up, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)
206    np.testing.assert_allclose(observed.down, expected_down, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)

247def test_router_credit_matches_full_forward_with_drop_renormalization():
248    logits = np.array(
249        [
250            [0.2, -1.1, 0.8, 2.0],
251            [-2, 0.1, 0.7, 1.4],
252            [0.2, 0.3, -0.2, 1.0],
253            [-80, -75, -90, -72],
254        ],
255        np.float64,
256    )
257    scores = np.array(
258        [
259            [0.2, -0.8, 1.1, 0.6],
260            [2, -3, 0.1, -0.8],
261            [0.4, 0.1, 1.2, -0.2],
262            [-0.4, 0.6, 0.1, 2],
263        ],
264        np.float64,
265    )
266    kept = np.array([[1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0, 1]], bool)
267    sigma = 0.005
268 
269    def evaluate(point):
270        mass = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.logaddexp(0, point), 1e-30))
271        weights = 2.5 * mass / (mass.sum(-1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)
272        surviving = np.where(kept, weights, 0).sum(-1, keepdims=True)
273        scale = np.where(
274            surviving > 0,
275            weights.sum(-1, keepdims=True) / np.where(surviving > 0, surviving, 1),
276            1,
277        )
278        return (np.where(kept, weights * scores, 0).sum(-1, keepdims=True) * scale)[:, 0]
279 
280    expected = np.zeros_like(logits)
281    for column in range(logits.shape[1]):
282        displacement = np.zeros_like(logits)
283        displacement[:, column] = sigma
284        expected[:, column] = (evaluate(logits + displacement) - evaluate(logits - displacement)) / (2 * sigma)
285    actual = jax.jit(
286        lambda x: sqrt_softplus_router_credit(x, jnp.asarray(scores), jnp.asarray(kept), sigma=sigma, renorm_sum=2.5)
287    )(jnp.asarray(logits))
288    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, atol=2e-7, rtol=2e-5)

43                x, selected, weights, up, down, credit = [
44                    jax.device_put(a, NamedSharding(mesh,p)) for a,p in zip(
45                        (x_np,selected_np,weights_np,up_np,down_np,credit_np), specs)]
46                def local_forward(x,selected,weights,up,down,credit):
47                    out,drops = _moe_mlp_ep_fixed_pooled_wave_a2a_local(
48                        x,selected,weights,jnp.ones(x.shape[0],jnp.bool_),up,down,
49                        activation_fn=lambda y: jnp.square(jax.nn.relu(y)),
50                        num_experts=4,capacity_factor=.7,token_sharding_axes=axes,
51                        transport_capacity_factor=.8,num_expert_waves=1,fp8_dispatch=False,
52                        expert_remat=False,report_assignment_keep=True)
53                    keep = drops.assignment_keep
54                    kept_sum = jnp.sum(jnp.where(keep,weights,0),axis=-1)
55                    scale = jnp.where(kept_sum>0, jnp.sum(weights,axis=-1)/jnp.maximum(kept_sum,1e-20),1)
56                    loss = jax.lax.psum(jnp.sum(out*scale[:,None]*credit),axes)
57                    return loss,jax.lax.psum(jnp.sum(~keep),axes)
58                native = jax.shard_map(local_forward,mesh=mesh,in_specs=specs,out_specs=(P(),P()),check_vma=False)
59                (_, dropped), expected = jax.jit(jax.value_and_grad(native,argnums=(3,4),has_aux=True))(
60                    x,selected,weights,up,down,credit)
61                actual = eqx.filter_jit(pooled_relu2_parameter_credit)(
62                    x,selected,weights,up,down,credit,capacity_factor=.7,
63                    transport_capacity_factor=.8,relative_step=.0001)
64                assert int(dropped)>0
65                # At this step scale no ReLU crossing occurs in the random test;
66                # the finite-cycle and derivative oracle agree to float32 precision.
67                for a,e in zip(actual,expected):
68                    np.testing.assert_allclose(a,e,atol=2e-4,rtol=2e-4)
69 
70                router = jax.device_put(router_np, NamedSharding(mesh,P(None,None)))
71                def router_objective(router):
72                    logits = jnp.einsum('td,de->te',x,router,out_sharding=P(axes,None))
73                    chosen = jnp.take_along_axis(logits,selected,axis=-1)
74                    mass = jnp.sqrt(jax.nn.softplus(chosen))
75                    combine = 2.5*mass/(mass.sum(axis=-1,keepdims=True)+1e-9)
76                    return native(x,selected,combine,up,down,credit)[0]
77                expected_router = jax.jit(jax.grad(router_objective))(router)
78                logits = jnp.einsum('td,de->te',x,router,out_sharding=P(axes,None))
79                chosen = jnp.take_along_axis(logits,selected,axis=-1)
80                actual_router = eqx.filter_jit(pooled_router_parameter_credit)(
81                    x,selected,chosen,up,down,credit,x,capacity_factor=.7,
82                    transport_capacity_factor=.8,sigma=.001,renorm_sum=2.5)
83                np.testing.assert_allclose(actual_router,expected_router,atol=2e-4,rtol=2e-4)
84        """,
85    )

59def assert_routed_reconstruction(
60    model_and_mesh,
61):
62    model, mesh = model_and_mesh
63    with jax.set_mesh(mesh):
64        tokens = jax.random.randint(jax.random.PRNGKey(31), (2, 128), 0, 128)
65        segments = jnp.broadcast_to(jnp.repeat(jnp.arange(2), 64)[None], tokens.shape)
66        mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, segment_ids=(segments, segments))
67        _, capture = eqx.filter_jit(capture_forward)(model, tokens, mask)
68        keys = jax.random.split(jax.random.PRNGKey(5), 12)
69        hub_credits = tuple(jax.random.normal(k, (2, 128, 64)) * 0.1 for k in keys)
70        actual = eqx.filter_jit(reconstruct_routed_experts)(model, capture, hub_credits, relative_step=0.0001)
71        routers = eqx.filter_jit(reconstruct_router_matrices)(model, capture, hub_credits, sigma=0.001)
72        expansions = eqx.filter_jit(reconstruct_latent_expansions)(model, capture, hub_credits)
73        convolutions = eqx.filter_jit(reconstruct_mlp_convolutions)(model, capture, hub_credits)
74        for index, layer in enumerate(model.layers()):
75 
76            def objective(layer, index=index):
77                output, _ = layer.mlp_branch(capture.stages[2 * index + 1].input, mask)
78                return jnp.sum(output * hub_credits[2 * index + 1])
79 
80            expected = eqx.filter_jit(eqx.filter_grad(objective))(layer)

4"""Train Snowball on synthetic tokens through the Levanter trainer and report step throughput.
5 
6A single-process, one-node harness (for example one Slurm job) that measures Snowball's real training
7step: mixed precision, Adam, the model's per-layer remat, and the trainer's own throughput and MFU
8logging. By default it uses the portable code paths: reference attention, and XLA ragged_dot when
9``RAGGED_DOT_IMPL=xla`` is set, which AMD GPUs need because the default kernels are CUDA-only. ``--attention``
10selects any Grug attention implementation.
11 
12Every step sees fresh uniform-random tokens and no example repeats, so no model can get below a loss of
13ln(vocab_size) (11.76 at full vocab). A loss that drops below that floor means something is leaking the
14targets. Checkpoints are never written. The trainer's forced final save of the 67B model plus Adam state would
15be about 1 TB, so the default hooks are replaced with the logging and profiler hooks only.
16 
17The default batch is one sequence per device. On a single device pass ``--batch-size 2``: a global batch of 1
18fails in the next-token loss (see ``main``).
19 
20Example, 8 GPUs, full 67B shape, one 4096-token sequence per GPU, profile of steps 10-12::
21 
22    RAGGED_DOT_IMPL=xla python experiments/grug/snowball_synthetic/train.py \\
23        --size full --steps 20 --profile-steps 3
24"""
25

211def main() -> None:
212    args = parse_args()
213    preset = PRESETS[args.size]
214    model_cfg = dataclasses.replace(
215        preset.model, attention_implementation=args.attention, moe_implementation=args.moe_impl
216    )
217    if args.layers is not None:
218        model_cfg = dataclasses.replace(model_cfg, num_layers=args.layers)
219    seq_len = preset.seq_len if args.seq_len is None else args.seq_len
220    batch_size = jax.device_count() if args.batch_size is None else args.batch_size
221    if batch_size == 1:
222        # jnp.roll in the next-token loss slices the (1, seq_len) token grid to (1, 1), and under an explicit mesh JAX
223        # drops the sharding of that slice, then rejects concatenating it with the (1, seq_len - 1) remainder.
224        raise ValueError("a global batch of 1 fails in the loss under explicit mesh axes; pass --batch-size 2 or more")
225    run_id = args.run_id or f"snowball-{args.size}-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}"
226 
227    trainer_cfg = build_trainer_config(args, preset, run_id, batch_size)
228    profile = args.profile_steps > 0
229 
230    def loss_function(model, example, *, key=None):
231        return model.compute_next_token_loss(example, key=key)
232 
233    levanter.trainer.initialize(trainer_cfg)
234    logger.info(
235        "size=%s layers=%d hidden=%d experts=%d topk=%d batch=%d seq_len=%d mp=%s expert_axis=%d context_axis=%d",
236        args.size,
237        model_cfg.num_layers,
238        model_cfg.hidden_dim,
239        model_cfg.num_experts,
240        model_cfg.num_experts_per_token,
241        batch_size,
242        seq_len,
243        trainer_cfg.mp,
244        args.expert_axis,
245        args.context_axis,
246    )
247    optimizer = AdamConfig(learning_rate=args.learning_rate, warmup=0.0).build(args.steps)
248    step_durations: list[float] = []
249 
250    def record_step(info: StepInfo, force: bool = False) -> None:
251        # The trainer re-runs every hook with force=True after the last step; that call would duplicate the sample.
252        if not force and info.step >= FIRST_TIMED_STEP:
253            step_durations.append(info.step_duration)
254 
255    with Trainer(trainer_cfg, optimizer, loss_function, add_default_hooks=False) as trainer:
256        Pos = model_cfg.max_Pos.resize(seq_len)
257        Vocab = Axis("vocab", model_cfg.vocab_size)
258        model_key, training_key = jrandom.split(jrandom.PRNGKey(trainer_cfg.seed))
259        flops_per_example = 3 * snowball_flops_per_token(model_cfg, Vocab.size, Pos.size) * Pos.size
260 
261        trainer.add_hook(callbacks.pbar_logger(total=args.steps), every=1)
262        trainer.add_hook(callbacks.log_step_info(args.steps, trainer_cfg.batch_schedule), every=1)
263        trainer.add_hook(
264            callbacks.log_performance_stats(Pos.size, trainer_cfg.batch_schedule, flops_per_example), every=1
265        )
266        trainer.add_hook(record_step, every=1)
267        if profile:
268            profile_steps = trainer_cfg.profiler.resolve_num_profile_steps(num_train_steps=args.steps)
269            profile_dir = str(trainer_cfg.log_dir / trainer.run_id / "profiler")
270            trainer.add_hook(
271                trainer_cfg.profiler.build(profile_dir, run_id=trainer.run_id, num_steps=profile_steps), every=1
272            )
273 
274        # Straight to the loader, not through LmDataConfig's mixer: the mixer draws in blocks of 2048 and
275        # wraps a shorter dataset back to its start, which would repeat examples and let the model memorize.
276        examples = synthetic_examples(args.steps * batch_size, seq_len, model_cfg.vocab_size)
277        train_dataset = NamedLmDataset(ListAsyncDataset(examples), Pos)
278        start = time.perf_counter()
279        state = trainer.initial_state(training_key, model_init=lambda: model_cfg.build(Vocab, key=model_key))
280        logger.info("initialized trainer state in %.1f s", time.perf_counter() - start)
281        report_memory()
282 
283        trainer.train(state, trainer.data_loader(train_dataset))
284        trainer.tracker.finish()
285 
286    if step_durations:
287        log_throughput_summary(step_durations, batch_size, seq_len, flops_per_example, args.steps)
288    report_memory()
289 
290 
291if __name__ == "__main__":
292    main()
